2025-02.daily_overview: On the fourth day of Chinese New Year, Yu Xiaowei's family welcomed her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng back from Shenzhen to Hong Kong for a reunion. In the morning, the whole family bought New Year goods, and at noon they had a lively reunion dinner. Her brother shared the development of insurtech in mainland China, which sparked her strong interest in cross-border business. In the evening, after her brother's family returned to Shenzhen, she searched for relevant information overnight, sowing the seeds for a new career direction. In the morning, she did a short stretch in the living room to wake up her body and store up energy for the lively day ahead.

events.name: Morning stretching to wake up
events.description: After getting up, Yu Xiaowei did a simple 10-minute stretch by the window in the living room, loosening her shoulders, neck, and back, to prepare her body for a busy day.

events.name: Lunar New Year family shopping and gathering
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, and her mother Chen Meiling went to Kowloon City Market to buy fresh ingredients and traditional Chinese New Year goods, preparing to welcome her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's family back to Hong Kong from Shenzhen. She specially bought strawberries, cherries, and dried shredded squid for the children at the market, and also made a detour to the Mong Kok Flower Market to add a pot of kumquats and a bunch of pussy willow, making the living room look festive.

events.name: Her younger brother shared about mainland insurance technology.
events.description: At noon, Yu Xiaofeng arrived with his wife and two children. The two families sat together for a hearty lunch, chatting about everyday life; the elders asked how things were going, and the children played noisily. After the meal, Yu Xiaofeng brought up the development of insurtech in mainland China, introducing innovative models such as intelligent underwriting and online claims in detail. He opened an app on his phone to demonstrate a mainland insurer's product. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully and asked questions from time to time, and an idea of cross-border cooperation began to take root in her mind.

events.name: Reluctant Farewell and Evening Study
events.description: After four in the afternoon, Yu Xiaofeng's family said goodbye. The two families exchanged red envelopes. Yu Xiaowei held her little nephew and told him to come back often. After the door closed, the house suddenly became quiet. In the evening, she sat alone in the study with her laptop, intensively searching for mainland insurtech materials, copying key cases and industry reports into a new notebook. She stayed busy until nearly 11 p.m. and only stopped when her husband urged her to rest. During that time, the cat jumped onto the desk and rubbed against her hand asking for attention; she was distracted for a moment to play with it, then buried herself in her work again.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Looking forward to it. After getting up, she discussed today's menu with her husband, smiling.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Excited but slightly tired, with the possibility of cross-border business swirling in her mind

2025-02.daily_overview: On the fifth day of Chinese New Year, Yu Xiaowei sorted out festival clutter at home in the morning. In the afternoon she dressed up specially, brought a family photo, and went to a class reunion at a restaurant in Mong Kok, where she gathered happily with old friends including Zhou Minyi and He Junjie. During the meal, she gained valuable information about the needs of high-net-worth clients in Shenzhen, but also felt anxious about He Junjie's industry difficulties, which reminded her of her husband's career prospects. After returning home late at night, she immediately organized the key points.

events.name: Morning home tidying
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei and her mother sorted and stored the Spring Festival decorations, fruit baskets, and leftover New Year goods by category. She also changed and washed the sheets in the guest room where her younger brother had slept, while her husband played with Lego in the living room with their children. Humming Spring Festival songs, she occasionally shared with her mother her thoughts about her younger brother's career success the day before.

events.name: Preparing to go to the class reunion
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowei bathed the children early, changed them into New Year Tang suits, and told her husband Zhang Weiming that there was prepared chicken and corn soup in the fridge. Then she spent half an hour putting on light makeup, deliberately choosing a beige cardigan and pearl earrings. She put the prepared family photo and the egg roll gifts for Zhou Minyi and He Junjie into her bag. Near 4:30, she walked alone to the Prince Edward Road West bus stop and took KMB Route 1A to Mong Kok.

events.name: Spring Festival dinner with high school classmates
events.description: From 5:30 to 8 PM, Yu Xiaowei happily gathered with six old classmates, including Zhou Minyi, He Junjie, and Wang Zhiyuan, in a private room at Xinghui Restaurant in Mong Kok. Zhou Minyi, holding a cup of Pu'er tea, talked at length about the new demand from Shenzhen's financial circle for Hong Kong high-end medical insurance and savings insurance. She suggested that Xiaowei focus on cross-border business and promised to refer potential clients. When Yu Xiaowei showed a family photo, Zhou Minyi looked at it and said softly, 'I really envy you — your family is all around you.' Yu Xiaowei smiled and patted her, without probing into that hint of loneliness. He Junjie took out a sales report and complained that new energy vehicles had cut the foot traffic at his Kowloon Bay showroom in half, feeling low. While eating siu mai, Yu Xiaowei silently took note of the key points and also felt a little more concern about the prospects for He Junjie's and her husband's industries.

events.name: Returning home to share and late-night review
events.description: At 8:20 p.m., the gathering ended. Yu Xiaowei hugged Zhou Minyi goodbye and promised to find her for tea next month if she went to Shenzhen. Then she took KMB Route 1A home, texting her husband on the way, "I'll be home soon." After arriving, she chatted with her husband Zhang Weiming on the living room sofa for twenty minutes, talking about Zhou Minyi's development and He Junjie's difficulties. Zhang Weiming also mentioned the impact of new technology in the air-conditioning industry. From 9:00 to 9:30, after washing up, Yu Xiaowei wrote down items one by one in her phone's memo app in the bedroom: potential client needs in Shenzhen, the referral opportunity from Zhou Minyi, and paying attention to changes in Weiming's industry. Then she sent Zhou Minyi a thank-you WeChat message, glanced through work group chats, and fell asleep on time at 10:00.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Relaxed, humming a tune while tidying the room

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Productive but slightly worried; decided to sleep well first and then plan countermeasures

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the Spring Festival holiday, Yu Xiaowei officially launched her spring nutrition plan. In the early morning, she unrolled her yoga mat to wake up her body. In the morning, she took her mother and her two children to the market, buying ingredients while teaching the kids to recognize vegetables. After returning home, she carefully designed a weekly menu and posted it in the kitchen. In the afternoon, while doing crafts with her daughter, the cat suddenly scratched and ruined the silk fabric, causing quite a flurry. In the evening, she read picture books with her children, savoring the last bit of slow time.

events.name: Morning yoga wake-up
events.description: At 7 a.m., while the children were still asleep, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in the living room and did a 20-minute Sun Salutation sequence and Cat-Cow pose to loosen up her shoulders and neck that had not been stretched for a while, warming up for getting back into a regular routine after the holiday. When she finished, she felt slightly sweaty and refreshed.

events.name: Family shopping for healthy ingredients.
events.description: Just after nine, Yu Xiaowei invited her mother Chen Meiling and the two children to go to the Kowloon City Market. Her son Zhang Zixuan took the initiative to help pull the shopping cart. Following the advice of their family doctor Zhou Wenbin, she focused on buying boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, chicken breast, chilled sea bass, spinach, apples, carrots, and celery. She also weighed out some snow fungus and sweet and bitter apricot kernels for making soup. At checkout, her daughter Zhang Yuxin asked for a bag of longan, and she smiled and put it into the basket.

events.name: Create the first week's nutrition menu.
events.description: In the afternoon, while the children were taking their naps, Yu Xiaowei took out her new binder, referred to online nutritious meal pairings, and carefully planned the three meals and afternoon vegetable-fruit juices for February 3 to 9: oatmeal porridge and boiled eggs were added to breakfast, lunch was multi-grain rice with fish or chicken breast, and dinner took into account the whole family's light taste. She neatly wrote the menu on two A4 sheets and stuck them to the kitchen memo board with magnets. Her husband walked by and praised, 'Impressive!'

events.name: The cat disrupts craft time
events.description: In the afternoon, while helping her daughter make a Cantonese embroidery collage, the family's tabby cat suddenly jumped onto the table and hooked its claws into the silk fabric, pulling out a strand of thread. The daughter was so upset she nearly cried. Yu Xiaowei comforted her daughter while carefully cutting away the tangled thread and teaching her daughter to re-thread the needle, taking the opportunity to tell her, "When doing crafts, you need to protect the materials, and also be patient with small animals."

events.name: Evening reading with the children.
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., after getting her daughter bathed, Yu Xiaowei sat on the living room rug with her daughter on her lap and her son leaning beside her. The three of them read Guess How Much I Love You and a Spring Festival-themed picture book, imitating rabbit movements from time to time. The children giggled while her husband watched the news nearby, and laughter filled the room.

start_state.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Refreshed and clear-headed, looking forward to starting the health plan

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Content and calm, confident about the regular life about to begin

2025-02.daily_overview: At the end of the holiday, Yu Xiaowei spent the day fully accompanying her family: in the morning she took her son to the nearby park to play football, in the afternoon she played with her daughter doing Yue embroidery appliqué, and in the evening she alone organized sales data and promotion materials in the study, making final preparations for returning to work the next day, her mood shifting between warmth and pressure.

events.name: Parent-child football time
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei let her husband catch up on sleep, and took her son Zhang Zixuan to the grass pitch at Kowloon Tsai Park to practice football basics. She taught him to pass with the inside of the foot and to trap the ball. Zixuan was sweating all over but didn't want to stop. She watched from a bench on the sidelines, called out Good shot from time to time, and sent videos to her husband.

events.name: Afternoon handicrafts at home
events.description: After afternoon tea, Yu Xiaowei took out her sewing box and several pieces of plain silk and did simple Yue embroidery appliqué with her daughter Zhang Yuxin, teaching her how to embroider a leaf with flat stitches. Her daughter learned seriously, but she couldn't help thinking of her teacher Wu Xiuying and planned to take her daughter to visit her next month. The two of them embroidered a small sun together, and her daughter proudly stuck it on the refrigerator.

events.name: Evening work review and preparation for promotion.
events.description: At eight in the evening, Yu Xiaowei went into the study, spread out last year's fourth-quarter sales ledger and customer satisfaction emails, reorganized the key performance data, and wrote three pages of talking points on team management ideas that Liang Zhenhua might ask about. Her husband Zhang Weiming came in halfway through to bring her a glass of hot lemon water. She looked up, smiled, and rubbed her temples. She worked until nearly 11 p.m. before closing her computer.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Light-hearted and happy, looking forward to playing soccer with my son.

end_state.location: Home study, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Slight pressure, but a settled feeling from being well prepared

2025-02.daily_overview: On the first workday after the holiday, Yu Xiaowei put on her power suit early in the morning and silently rehearsed the key points during the ride. In the morning, an urgent meeting announced a structural reorganization. In the afternoon, she mustered up the courage to request a talk about promotion, but was stopped short by her boss's remark, "Let's see the overall arrangement." After work, she poured out her feelings to Su Lishan; after returning home, she had a long talk with her husband until late at night. She then turned the pressure into even more frenzied drive. Before bed, she tried to meditate but only lasted 3 minutes because her thoughts were scattered.

events.name: Thoughts on the commute.
events.description: At 6:45 a.m., Yu Xiaowei quickly changed into her tailored suit, took two quick bites of whole-wheat toast, exchanged a few words with her mother and husband, and headed out. From Kowloon City, she took a bus and then transferred to the MTR to Wan Chai. During the nearly one-hour ride, she kept fine-tuning on her phone's memo app the performance comparison chart she would use for the meeting with Liang Zhenhua, her palms slightly sweating.

events.name: Emergency restructuring meeting
events.description: At nine in the morning, in the meeting room at the AIA Building, regional sales director Liang Zhenhua used a projector to announce the regional structure optimization plan. The original teams would be split and reorganized, and some reporting lines would be adjusted. Yu Xiaowei, sitting in the second row, quickly jotted down a note that her team might be merged into another group. She raised her hand to ask about the client handover process, her voice calm but her heart racing.

events.name: Have a private talk to seek a promotion.
events.description: At 3 p.m., after waiting for Liang Zhenhua to return to the office, Yu Xiaowei knocked and entered, handed over the printed personal performance overview, honestly expressed her desire to be promoted to deputy manager, and laid out her plan to lead a team to develop high-net-worth clients in the future. Liang Zhenhua looked through it and was silent for a moment, finally responding only, 'I'll review the overall arrangement again.' Yu Xiaowei detected the reservation in his tone, forced herself to keep smiling as she walked out, and composed herself in the restroom for five minutes.

events.name: Sharing feelings at the café and encouraging each other
events.description: After work, Yu Xiaowei dragged Su Lishan to the Tsui Wah Restaurant on the ground floor of the AIA Building. They each ordered an iced red bean drink, and she poured out all the uncertainty about the upcoming meeting. Su Lishan also shared the ups and downs of her own promotion battle last year. The two agreed that no matter how the organizational structure changed, they would carve out a path with their results and be each other's mirror.

events.name: In the evening, confiding in her husband and planning the next actions.
events.description: Arrived home at 8 p.m.; the children had already eaten. Her husband, Zhang Weiming, noticed she looked upset, and after dinner he voluntarily washed the dishes and led her to sit by the bay window. Yu Xiaowei poured out everything that had happened that day. After listening patiently, her husband comforted her, saying, “You've always been so capable, don't lose heart.” At ten, Yu Xiaowei returned to the study, re-selected 20 high-potential clients, and spread a two-week visit plan across the desk. Then she called Li Guodong at HSBC and arranged to meet him during tomorrow's lunch break for financial advice. Before bed, she tried to meditate for 5 minutes in the bedroom, but the day's conversations kept replaying in her head, and she gave up after barely managing 3 minutes.

start_state.location: On the MTR Tsuen Wan Line train
start_state.mood: Nervous but full of fighting spirit

end_state.location: Home study, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Unwilling to accept it, but quickly switched into battle mode

2025-02.daily_overview: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowei completed strength training according to the spring plan. In the morning, she rushed to follow up with clients. During her lunch break, she hurried to HSBC to finalize the family wealth management plan. In the afternoon, she continued meeting clients. In the evening, she went home and executed the first transfer, sharing the steady wealth management plan with her husband. The sense of fulfillment temporarily overshadowed yesterday's setbacks.

events.name: Morning strength training
events.description: At 6:45 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei unrolled her yoga mat and picked up a 5 kg resistance band, then did a 20-minute full-body strength workout in a corner of the bedroom: 3 sets of bodyweight squats, 3 sets of resistance band rows, 3 sets of glute bridges, finishing with stretching. Wearing earphones, she listened to a motivational podcast; sweat soaked her sports top. After a shower, she felt her body activated.

events.name: Morning client visits and relationship maintenance
events.description: After returning to the company, Yu Xiaowei followed last night's list and first made Chinese New Year greeting calls to three long-time clients, also updating their family insurance policies. Then she met with a nearby small business owner to explain in person the newly launched high-end supplementary medical insurance. Although no policy was signed on the spot, the client said he would consider it.

events.name: Went to HSBC during lunch break to finalize the wealth management plan
events.description: At 12:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei walked out of the AIA Building and walked ten minutes to HSBC on Hennessy Road. The client manager, Li Guodong, was already waiting in the meeting room. She took out the list of questions she had prepared in advance and consulted in detail about savings insurance and bond funds. In the end, she decided to transfer 50,000 Hong Kong dollars in idle funds into wealth management accounts in batches: 30,000 into a savings insurance account, 20,000 into a bond fund portfolio, and set a follow-up plan for monthly automatic investment of 8,000 Hong Kong dollars.

events.name: Evening: executing transfers and family communication.
events.description: At 8 p.m., after the family had eaten dinner, Yu Xiaowei opened HSBC Mobile Banking, transferred the first 30,000 Hong Kong dollars into the newly opened savings insurance and wealth management account, took a screenshot and sent it to her husband Zhang Weiming, and wrote down family financial goals on the small whiteboard in the living room with a marker. Her husband put his arm around her shoulder and said, “Whatever you say.” She laughed and playfully punched him.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Woken by the alarm, I was still drowsy, but quickly became alert after getting up.

2025-02.daily_overview: On a Friday workday, Yu Xiaowei met with her team during the day. During her lunch break, Su Lishan pulled her into a discussion about beauty treatments, and they hit it off immediately. After work, the two went straight to Causeway Bay to try it out and jointly bought monthly passes, adding a regular stress-relief ritual from then on. When she got home in the evening, she also simmered a green radish, carrot, and pork bone soup with her mother. Before bed, she received a morning run invitation from her running buddy Shen Peiwen.

events.name: Team lunch and care invitation
events.description: During the lunch break, Su Lishan brought takeout pineapple buns and milk tea to the desk opposite Yu Xiaowei and said she knew of a newly opened beauty salon offering facial skin rejuvenation. She suggested they buy a monthly membership card together and split the cost, going together every Friday after work. Yu Xiaowei thought it was exactly a good way to relieve stress, immediately checked online reviews, and the two settled it on the spot.

events.name: First beauty experience in Causeway Bay and jointly purchasing a monthly card
events.description: After finishing work at 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan took the MTR to Huanbai Beauty Studio in Causeway Bay. The two each had a 45-minute deep cleansing and collagen regeneration treatment. Yu Xiaowei was very satisfied with the beautician's technique and the environment, and her skin was visibly brighter afterward. They didn't hesitate to buy a monthly double treatment card together, each paying 1,200 yuan per month, and agreed to return next Friday at the same time.

events.name: The night mother made soup.
events.description: When she got home a little after eight in the evening, her mother Chen Meiling was simmering pork bone soup with green radish and carrot in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowei went over to help slice ginger while listening to her mother talk about how her father had won two rounds of chess in the park that afternoon. She ladled herself a bowl of soup and slowly drank it, blowing on it, feeling that most of the day's work fatigue had melted away.

events.name: Running buddy invitation and pre-bed browsing
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei went to the children's room as usual to check on the kids. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin was already asleep, with a crayon drawing titled "Mommy and Me" beside the pillow. She gently picked it up and pinned it on the family bulletin board. Back in the bedroom, her phone buzzed with a WeChat message from her running buddy Shen Peiwen, inviting her to go for an early seaside morning run on Monday. Yu Xiaowei happily agreed, and after chatting for ten minutes about training and recovery tips, they said goodnight to each other.

start_state.mood: In good spirits, and she deliberately used new lipstick when getting dressed.

2025-02.daily_overview: Although it was Saturday, she had to work because of the Chinese New Year compensatory workday arrangement. After arriving at the office, Yu Xiaowei submitted her annual leave request for the following Monday, dealt with the backlog of emails as quickly as possible, and called her mother-in-law during the lunch break to confirm the details of the physical exam. After getting off work, to make up for missing time with the kids over the weekend, she took them to a stationery store to pick out supplies for the new semester. In the evening, she packed the backpack for tomorrow’s Ocean Park trip in advance, and walked slowly on the treadmill for 20 minutes for the first time to adjust her condition.

events.name: Submit annual leave request.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Yu Xiaowei submitted an annual leave request for February 10 in the OA system, and Liang Zhenhua quickly approved it online. She also sorted out the two insurance policies she hadn't finished the day before, then began replying to a dozen or so year-end emails, working until her forehead began to glisten with oil before stopping.

events.name: Contact mother-in-law during lunch break
events.description: At lunchtime, Yu Xiaowei ordered wonton noodles for delivery and, while eating, called her mother-in-law Li Shufen to remind her that she would pick her up in Kwun Tong at 7:30 Monday morning, that she needed to fast before the medical check-up, and also asked if she had coughed recently. Her mother-in-law's voice was loud and clear, which reassured her.

events.name: After-work family shopping and first try on the treadmill.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei deliberately finished work early. After returning home, she took her two excited children and walked with her husband to a stationery shop on Prince Edward Road West, where they bought a soccer-pattern pencil case for her son and a pink mechanical pencil for her daughter. After dinner, she used the new folding treadmill at home to walk slowly for 20 minutes at a pace of 8:30, as an attempt to regain the feel of physical activity.

events.name: Preparing the Ocean Park backpack and taking a Cantonese embroidery break.
events.description: Then she neatly packed the water bottle, snacks, wet wipes, sun hat, and annual pass needed for tomorrow's Ocean Park trip into the mommy bag, and wrote on a note a few snacks that Lin Jiaxin's son likes, to buy the next morning. At nine in the evening, Yu Xiaowei picked up the previously unfinished small lychee embroidery piece, lit a lavender candle, and slowly embroidered leaves for half an hour under the light, soothing the fatigue of the day's work.

2025-02.daily_overview: To fulfill the Spring Festival promise to her best friend Lin Jiaxin, Yu Xiaowei left early in the morning with her daughter and spent a full, rich day at Ocean Park: from the Ocean Wonders exhibits to the dolphin show and then the kids' playground. The two mothers chatted on a bench about the frustrations of parenting and work, and the children's laughter dispelled all the post-holiday fatigue.

events.name: Woke up her daughter in the early morning and did shopping before departure.
events.description: At seven in the morning, Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin put on a pink hoodie and sneakers and braided her hair into two pigtails. Before leaving, she specially detoured to the bakery at the market to buy cocktail buns and Vitasoy for breakfast, then bought Chupa Chups and cheese sausages at the convenience store because Lin Haoyu liked them.

events.name: Meet up with my best friend at the main entrance of Ocean Park.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter's hand and took the MTR to the main entrance of Ocean Park. Lin Jiaxin and her son Lin Haoyu were already waiting by the ticket office. As soon as the two children saw each other, they jumped up holding hands. The mothers smiled, had their tickets checked, and entered the park, first taking a group photo in front of the giant lantern installation with the blue sky as the background.

events.name: Morning visit and dolphin show
events.description: From ten o'clock to noon, the four of them first entered the Ocean Wonder Pavilion to see the giant manta rays and coral reefs. The two little children pressed against the glass and gasped again and again. Then they visited the Panda Pavilion and the Ocean Theatre to watch dolphins leap, and the children clapped until their hands were red with excitement. Yu Xiaowei held up her phone and took dozens of photos in a row, then asked passersby to take a few group photos of them together.

events.name: Deep talk over lunch at Hailongwang Restaurant.
events.description: At noon at the Sea Dragon King Restaurant, Yu Xiaowei ordered a kids' meal for her daughter, while she and Lin Jiaxin each had roast goose rice and iced lemon tea. While the children were focused on poking at their rice balls, Lin Jiaxin talked about the troubles of staff changes at school, and Yu Xiaowei shared her own experiences with organizational restructuring and being passed over for promotion. The two encouraged each other and sighed about how hard life is after thirty.

events.name: Afternoon adventure and commemorative photos
events.description: After the meal, the four of them visited the Ocean Tower, Shark Aquarium, and Polar Speed mini-roller coaster one after another. Her son Lin Haoyu laughed so hard on the roller coaster that he drooled. At 3 p.m., by the fountain in front of Ocean Wonders, the two mothers took many group photos of the children, then used a selfie stick to capture a lively picture of the four of them hugging together. They agreed on a monthly parent-child trip.

events.name: The return trip, still savoring it.
events.description: At 4 p.m., the two families reluctantly said goodbye at the front gate. Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin high-fived to confirm next month's afternoon tea time. On the subway ride home, her daughter fell asleep leaning against her from exhaustion. She gently stroked her daughter's forehead and, as soon as she got home, sent the photos to the family group and the close-friends group, receiving a long string of likes.

start_state.location: MTR Kowloon Tong Station Platform
start_state.mood: Elated, as excited as if she were going on a spring outing herself.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Extremely satisfied, healed by my best friend's company and my daughter's joy.

2025-02.daily_overview: Yu Xiaowei took time off work to accompany her mother-in-law throughout her medical checkup at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. She supported her along the way and communicated patiently. All indicators were normal, which was a relief. While waiting, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law chatted about family matters, deepening their bond. After the checkup, she took her mother-in-law home, then hurried back to the company to handle urgent matters. In the early morning, as agreed, she jogged by the seaside with her running partner Shen Peiwen, starting an energetic Monday.

events.name: Morning run along the waterfront with running buddy Shen Peiwen.
events.description: At six in the morning, Yu Xiaowei put on running shoes and a breathable top, met Shen Peiwen at the Kowloon City waterfront promenade, and the two jogged 5 km along Avenue of Stars at a pace of 7:15, chatting about Chinese New Year anecdotes and training plans. After the run, Yu Xiaowei bought two bottles of water at a convenience store, high-fived Shen Peiwen to say goodbye, then hurried home to shower and change, ready to accompany her mother-in-law.

events.name: Pick up my mother-in-law and go to the hospital
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei asked her husband to take the two children to school, then took a taxi to Golden Bridge Mansion on Hong Ning Road in Kwun Tong to pick up her mother-in-law Li Shufen, thoughtfully bringing a shawl for the air conditioning. On the way, she held her mother-in-law's hand and told her to relax, and also mentioned that her grandson Zhang Zixuan had received an A on his math quiz.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowei focused on her debut in the international Cantonese embroidery online community. In the morning she carefully prepared her works and demonstration, and in the afternoon she presented smoothly in a video conference, earning high praise from international embroidery friends, which greatly strengthened her confidence in passing on the craft. In the evening she spent warm time with her family.

events.name: Preparing for an international Cantonese embroidery community video exchange
events.description: On the morning of February 16, Yu Xiaowei made final preparations in her home study for the afternoon's international Cantonese embroidery online community video exchange. She took out her most recent favorite work, "Peony Painting," from the embroidery cabinet, fixed her phone with a stand, and took several high-definition detail photos. Then she organized her creative inspiration and key stitching points in a notebook, highlighting the use of rolling stitch and overlapping stitch. She opened the embroidery hoop and repeatedly practiced the demonstration steps of the core stitches with silk thread to ensure she could clearly show them in front of the camera. Just before the meeting, she tested the study's internet connection, camera, and microphone, confirming that the video and audio were working well.

events.name: Debut in the international Cantonese embroidery community
events.description: At 3:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei logged into the video conferencing software on time and joined the exchange meeting of the international Cantonese embroidery online community. Guided by the host, she gathered her courage and, in fluent Cantonese, showed her 'Peony Painting' to embroidery friends from Singapore, Malaysia, Canada and other places. She shared in detail how the design was inspired by the spring peonies at Prince Edward Flower Market, how the colors captured the layering of the petals, and how the composition drew on traditional flower-and-bird painting. As she explained, she also demonstrated live the rolling stitch and layering stitch techniques used in the work, and answered questions from several embroidery friends about silk thread selection and securing techniques. Her patience and professionalism earned her a screen full of likes and comments saying 'amazing', and the community administrator also invited her to give a featured talk next time. The atmosphere was warm and lively.

events.name: Sharing the warmth of family after success.
events.description: After the exchange meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei felt uplifted and returned to the living room to share the joy with her husband Zhang Weiming and their two children. She held her daughter Xiaoyuxin close and showed her son the screenshots of likes on her work on her phone, while her husband encouraged her to continue developing this hobby. The family sat around the TV and watched an episode of an animated series, then Yu Xiaowei told the children bedtime stories. After they fell asleep, she was still savoring the affirmation from the afternoon, and her love for Cantonese embroidery became even stronger.

events.description: The day after the video exchange meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei logged into the international Cantonese embroidery community on her phone during her commute to work. She replied one by one to follow-up questions from embroidery friends about her "Peony Painting", and proactively added three embroidery friends she had interacted with most during the exchange as contacts. One of them, from Malaysia, specially invited her to participate in next month's themed creation. She browsed works by other members in the community album, particularly appreciated a piece of Cantonese embroidery that incorporated Middle Eastern geometric patterns, and left a comment praising it. She deeply felt the charm of traditional craftsmanship transcending regions, left messages in Cantonese and English in the group to express gratitude, and silently looked forward to a future opportunity to bring Cantonese embroidery beyond Hong Kong and participate in international exchange.

events.description: After work, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR home, browsing more works in the community album on her phone along the way. Yu Xiaowei asked her son about his first day of class; Zixuan excitedly showed his new textbooks, and her daughter imitated the spinning move taught by the ballet teacher. After dinner, she checked Zixuan's homework and drew with Yuxin for a while. At 9:30 p.m., after putting both children to bed, Yu Xiaowei spread out drawing paper and 2B pencils in the study and began to conceive a Year of the Tiger themed Cantonese embroidery piece called 'Tiger Roaring in the Mountain Forest.' Combining the stitch characteristics of traditional Cantonese embroidery, she pulled up reference photos of tigers on her phone and repeatedly sketched the tiger's outline, hair growth direction, and color gradations on paper, finally producing a complete pencil design sketch and roughly marking color areas with colored pencils. Because she had a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea in the evening, she was slightly excited and tossed and turned for about half an hour before falling asleep.

She used black and yellow silk thread to embroider the tiger's tail, using curved stitches to express its movement. Then she began embroidering the bamboo leaves and flowers in the background, using green silk thread with long and short stitches to outline the bamboo leaves, and adding a few small red flowers to make the scene richer. She remembered Ms. Wu saying that Cantonese embroidery values "dense but not chaotic," so she paid special attention to even stitch density. The work lasted about two hours, and by 11 p.m. she was satisfied as she admired the gradually enriching picture. Before bed, she did a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch because her shoulders felt stiff from sitting for so long.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Thursday, after an early morning strength workout, Yu Xiaowei completed the final draft of the Shenzhen sharing session PPT in the morning. In the evening, she jogged six kilometers with her running buddy Shen Peiwen along the Kwun Tong Promenade and had dinner together, pouring out stress and deepening their friendship. However, after the run, her right knee was slightly sore, so she immediately applied ice and stretched. At night, she made fine refinements to her Year of the Tiger artwork and organized the month's food diary to send to her doctor, receiving affirmation.

events.name: Morning strength training
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei did her Thursday strength training, focusing on the lower body today: squat jumps, walking lunges, and calf raises, combined with lateral band walks to improve running stability. After 5 minutes of meditation, she left for work.

events.name: Finalized the PPT for the Shenzhen sharing session.
events.description: In the morning at the office, Yu Xiaowei made the final round of revisions to the Shenzhen sharing session PPT based on the feedback she had collected: she unified the fonts, added animations, and updated the latest data in Wang Qiming's case. She finalized it, saved it to her work computer with encryption, and also backed it up to the cloud. She sent the PPT to Guo Junwei and Su Lishan, asking for final confirmation.

events.name: Went to Kwun Tong for a night run with a running buddy
events.description: At 5:30 PM, Yu Xiaowei changed into running shorts and a quick-dry T-shirt at her home in Kowloon City District, took her water bottle and phone, and checked her running shoes. Then she drove the family car to the Kwun Tong Promenade, arriving around 6:00 PM. After parking, she did several sets of high-knee warm-ups. Her running partner Shen Peiwen was already there waiting. At 6:15 PM, the two began a six-kilometer jog along the Kwun Tong Promenade at a pace of about 6 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, with a gentle sea breeze making it very pleasant. During the run, Shen Peiwen shared amusing anecdotes about taking her students to a recitation contest, while Yu Xiaowei talked about how busy work had been in February and her worries about changes in her husband's industry. Shen Peiwen comforted her, saying that with her abilities she would definitely get through the difficulties. After the run, the two did a full set of stretches. But while stretching, Yu Xiaowei felt slight soreness on the outside of her right knee; Shen Peiwen applied an ice pack and suggested reducing her running mileage for two days.

events.name: Catching up at a Hong Kong-style tea restaurant after the run.
events.description: After the run, at a nearby Hong Kong-style tea restaurant, the two each ordered a piping hot bowl of wonton noodles and a cup of hot soy milk, and sat by the window eating and chatting. The conversation turned to their respective families. Shen Peiwen revealed that she was worried about being urged to get married, and Yu Xiaowei joked that she would introduce her to a fine young man from among her insurance clients. They talked for about forty minutes, and their friendship became stronger through laughter. At 8 PM, Yu Xiaowei drove home. Her knee was still slightly uncomfortable, so she decided to rest the next day.

events.name: Tiger Year Cantonese embroidery detail refinement
events.description: After putting the child to bed in the evening, Yu Xiaowei went to her study to refine the details of the Year of the Tiger Cantonese embroidery. She compared it against the design draft and used white silk thread to embroider the tiger's eyebrows and whiskers one by one, making each strand distinct. She also checked the overall color scheme and added several layers of light yellow silk thread on the tiger's belly to create smoother transitions. Using seed stitch, she embroidered the stamens of a few small flowers in the bamboo leaves of the background, and the piece instantly became much more refined. The work lasted about an hour and a half. After finishing, she gently cleaned the embroidery surface with a soft brush and took photos to keep.

events.name: Organize the diet diary and provide feedback to the doctor.
events.description: After finishing her embroidery at nearly 11 o'clock, Yu Xiaowei sorted out this month's diet diary and exercise records, and tallied the number of execution days and results: the overall adherence rate reached 95%, her weight dropped 1.0 kg from the beginning of the month to 55.0 kg, and her waist measurement decreased by 1.5 cm. She called her family doctor Zhou Wenbin to report on the implementation of this month's training and nutrition plan, including training completion, weight changes, and how she felt physically. Based on her feedback, Dr. Zhou suggested continuing to consume high-quality protein and appropriately increasing complex carbohydrates to support marathon training, and acknowledged her phased achievements. After thanking him, Yu Xiaowei noted the new suggestions in her phone memo.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but kept exercising.

end_state.location: Home study room
end_state.mood: Pleasant social interaction after exercise, but knee discomfort needs attention; health results were recognized, giving a strong sense of achievement.

2025-02.daily_overview: Friday, the last day of the month. Yu Xiaowei rested due to knee discomfort, only doing morning meditation and evening stretching. In the morning she handled remaining policies; in the afternoon she reviewed month-end performance, found she was behind target, made a March sprint plan and submitted it to her supervisor. After work she had a monthly family finance meeting with her husband and adjusted the budget. In the evening she finished the framing of the Cantonese embroidery for the Year of the Tiger, and the piece turned out perfectly. Before bed she did 10 minutes of evening stretching and recorded her meals.

events.name: Morning meditation and gentle stretching.
events.description: At 6:30 on the morning of February 28, Yu Xiaowei decided to let her knee rest and did 20 minutes of meditation in the living room, combined with gentle seated forward folds and cat-cow poses, avoiding standing postures. She still felt slight soreness in her knee, but it was better than last night. After meditation, she recorded her meal plan. For breakfast, she drank a homemade protein smoothie (strawberry + banana + protein powder).

events.name: Process insurance policy renewals in the morning.
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei was in the office handling the last batch of policies expiring this month and confirming the renewal rate. Her colleague Su Lishan reminded her that today was Friday and also the end of the month, the deadline for the final sales push. She felt a little pressure.

events.name: End-of-month performance review
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei logged into the company's sales system in her office, retrieved her February personal sales data, and checked core indicators one by one, including the number of new policies, premium income, and client referral rate, comparing them with the targets set at the beginning of the year. She found that new policy premiums were about 12% behind target, mainly because two large policies had been delayed to the following month. She calmly recorded the specific gap data and thought about countermeasures.

events.name: Formulate the March sprint plan and submit it.
events.description: Based on the performance gap, she immediately made a detailed sprint plan for March, highlighting three potential high-net-worth clients: Wang Qiming from Shenzhen (to advance cross-border group insurance), Mrs. Lin referred by Mrs. Chen (to follow up after a phone appointment), and the client who recently increased coverage. She developed a visit plan and expected premium contribution for each client, set clear weekly action targets, and created a written schedule. Then she sent the schedule to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua via the company's internal messaging software with the note 'I will definitely catch up in March' and asked for guidance.

events.name: Monthly family finance meeting
events.description: Returning home from work in the evening, after dinner, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming held the monthly family financial meeting at the living room dining table. They opened the bookkeeping app and handwritten ledger and checked the February income and expenditure details item by item: Yu Xiaowei's salary transfer, daily household expenses, the children's ballet tuition, and the monthly amortization of the care card. This month's total spending exceeded the plan by about 1,000 Hong Kong dollars, mainly for embroidery thread and yoga mats. They reaffirmed their goal of saving 8,000 Hong Kong dollars per month, and because orders in the repair and maintenance industry had recently declined, they decided to reassess the size of the family emergency fund at the beginning of next quarter and possibly postpone additional investment. Zhang Weiming mentioned that he had received several electric taxi repair orders this month, which was a little reassuring. The couple also discussed the regular fund investment suggested by her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and decided to research it before acting. Finally, Yu Xiaowei summarized the discussion and recorded in the family finance notebook next month's savings goal, the emergency fund review plan, and the decision to moderately reduce the dining-out budget.

events.name: A warm flow of family emotional support
events.description: After the finance meeting, Yu Xiaowei received a drawing from her daughter — a note covered in hearts with 'Mom, you've worked hard' written crookedly on it, and her eyes welled up. Her son also took the initiative to help his younger sister clean up the toys. Her husband gently hugged her shoulders from behind and said he would take more orders next month to share the burden. She felt her family was her strong support.

events.name: Tiger Year Cantonese embroidery finishing and framing
events.description: After coaxing the child to sleep at night, Yu Xiaowei made the final finishing touches on her Year of the Tiger Cantonese embroidery in the living room. She checked the entire piece, trimmed excess threads with small scissors, and gently ironed the embroidered surface with a low-temperature iron to make it smooth. Then she carefully removed the embroidery from the hoop and mounted it into a mahogany-colored picture frame prepared in advance. She admired the finished work — a majestic yet slightly cute tiger vividly appearing on the fabric, with bamboo leaves swaying in the background and auspicious clouds surrounding it, all in dense stitches. Filled with a sense of accomplishment, she took a photo and shared it in the embroidery friends WeChat group, and instantly received likes from He Meiling and Teacher Wu. She planned to bring it to Teacher Wu next week for in-person feedback.

events.name: Evening Stretching and Diet Record
events.description: After the framing was finished, it was nearly 11 p.m. Yu Xiaowei did a 10-minute evening stretch on the bed, focusing on relaxing her lower back and legs, and recorded the day's diet and knee condition. She planned to keep watching her knee the next morning and to resume light running if it improved. When she turned off the light to sleep, she silently recited the goals and plans for March and drifted off to sleep, tired but expectant.

end_state.mood: Relieved; completing the work and family support gave her strength, and her knee improvement restored her confidence.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the early morning of New Year's Day, the whole family went to Victoria Peak to welcome the first ray of sunshine of the New Year. Yu Xiaowei and her husband wrote down their goals on wish cards, and the family gathered warmly together. In the afternoon, she tried making pour-over coffee and posted on Moments, chatting at length with her best friend Huang Wenhui about New Year plans. Recharging on both friendship and family fronts, she started a year of hard work.

events.name: The whole family got up early to prepare for a hike to welcome the new year.
events.description: At 4 a.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming woke up their son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin, helped the children put on warm coats, and prepared a thermos, camera, and wish cards. The family set off lightly for the top of Victoria Peak.

events.name: Drove to Victoria Peak
events.description: At 4:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's family drove a private car from Kowloon City District, took the Cross-Harbour Tunnel to Hong Kong Island, and arrived at the parking lot near the Peak Tram station in about 25 minutes, then walked to the Peak Tower viewing deck. On the way, Yu Xiaowei reminded the children to stay quiet and be safe.

events.name: Waiting for sunrise at The Peak Tower
events.description: At around 5 a.m., the family arrived at the viewing platform, where there were already many tourists. Yu Xiaowei held their daughter, Zhang Weiming held their son's hand, and they found a good spot. As they admired the dazzling night view of Victoria Harbour, they excitedly chatted about their New Year plans, and Yu Xiaowei took photos with her phone.

events.name: Welcoming the sunrise and making a wish
events.description: At 6:05 a.m., the New Year sun rose, and the whole family cheered. Yu Xiaowei took out the wish cards and wrote, "Promotion to deputy manager, half marathon under 2 hours." Zhang Weiming quietly added, "Keep your own pace." Their son drew a car, and their daughter drew a heart. Together they hung the wish cards on the wishing wall and took a group photo.

events.name: Walked down the mountain and returned home
events.description: After sunrise at around 7 o'clock, the crowds gradually grew. The family took the Peak Tram downhill and drove back to Kowloon City District. The children dozed in the car while Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming quietly talked about New Year plans. They arrived home around 8 o'clock.

events.name: Family breakfast sharing.
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Mother Chen Meiling had already prepared breakfast: Hong Kong-style milk tea, pineapple buns with butter, and fried eggs. The whole family sat around the table; Yu Xiaowei shared the wishes she had written on the mountaintop, Zhang Weiming explained the words he had added, and the children showed their drawings. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei sent the photos to the family WeChat group.

events.name: Tried pour-over coffee in the afternoon
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei learned to make pour-over coffee in her kitchen using new pour-over equipment. Following the steps to weigh the beans, grind, and pour water, she successfully made a cup and took photos from multiple angles to document it.

events.name: Posting on Moments and interacting with close friends
events.description: Yu Xiaowei posted the coffee photo on Moments with the caption, "New attempt: hand-brewed coffee, kicking off a wonderful afternoon in 2025!" Her best friend Huang Wenhui immediately commented teasingly, and the two then switched to a private chat and talked deeply for half an hour about New Year plans and reflections on the development of Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Yu Xiaowei felt the warmth of friendship.

2025-01.daily_overview: Saturday was family health day and ballet class day. In the morning, she first took her daughter to ballet class, then the whole family went to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for their annual check-up, received professional advice from the doctor, and then enjoyed family time over yum cha; in the afternoon they went home to rest and organize the check-up report, while also searching for core strength training videos to prepare for tomorrow's training after the morning run.

events.name: Arranged a morning run with a running buddy
events.description: Early in the morning, Yu Xiaowei communicated with her running buddy Shen Peiwen via WeChat, confirming that they would meet at the Shing Mun Riverside Park entrance in Sha Tin at 7 a.m. on January 12 for a morning run, and agreeing to bring water and energy gels.

events.name: Take daughter to ballet class.
events.description: At 8:45 a.m., Yu Xiaowei first took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the dance studio in Kowloon Tong for a 9:00-9:45 ballet class, while her husband Zhang Weiming took their son to make preparations for the checkup at home. After class, she picked up her daughter, and the whole family set off for Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital around 9:15.

events.name: The whole family set out for their annual physical examination.
events.description: At 9:15 a.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband dressed and washed the two children, then checked and brought the medical insurance card, physical examination appointment form, and other items. Zhang Weiming drove, and the family left their home in Kowloon City District for Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital on Bonham Road in the Central and Western District, arriving around 9:45.

events.name: Physical examination at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital.
events.description: After arriving at 9:45, the family checked in at the self-service terminal in the outpatient hall, then underwent basic examinations including height, weight, blood pressure, complete blood count, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound. The parents comforted the children while waiting. Yu Xiaowei also added a consultation request related to marathon training. The entire physical examination took about 1.5 hours and ended at 11:15.

events.name: Family Doctor Report Interpretation
events.description: After the physical examination, family doctor Zhou Wenbin gave one-on-one report interpretations for the whole family in the consultation room. Regarding marathon training, Dr. Zhou combined Yu Xiaowei's heart rate, blood oxygen, and joint condition to give recommendations on electrolyte supplementation, core strengthening, and pre-race tapering; reminded Zhang Weiming to monitor his blood pressure; provided dietary guidance for the children; and updated the family's electronic health records. The interpretation took about 30 minutes and ended at 11:45.

events.name: Family yum cha
events.description: At 11:50 am, they left the hospital and the family walked to a nearby Hong Kong-style tea restaurant, ordering shrimp dumplings, siu mai, barbecue pork buns, chicken feet, and Yu Xiaowei's favorites, pineapple bun with butter and Hong Kong-style milk tea. The children had egg tarts and iced lemon tea. During the meal they chatted about funny moments from the checkup and discussed next week's activities. Yu Xiaowei paid the bill by credit card; the meal ended around 12:50.

events.name: Returned home to tidy up and study.
events.description: After returning home at 1:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei put the two children down for their nap, organized her medical examination report herself, took photos of the doctor's recommended exercise and diet plan and sent them to the family group. Then she searched on her phone for 'runner core strength training', saved three instructional videos, and decided to try them after tomorrow morning's run.

events.name: Set off for a morning run.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Yu Xiaowei got up, put on her running gear, put her phone, water, and energy gels into her waist pack, fed her pet cat, then left home and took the MTR to Sha Tin.

events.name: Easy 15 km run with Shen Peiwen
events.description: At 7 o'clock, Yu Xiaowei met Shen Peiwen at the entrance of the Shing Mun Riverside Park. The two completed a 15-kilometer run along the riverbank at about a 7:00 pace (easy run pace). Along the way, they chatted about Spring Festival family plans and parenting trivia. Shen Peiwen suggested trying trail running routes such as the MacLehose Trail, and Yu Xiaowei said she was very interested.

events.name: First experience with strength training after running
events.description: After the run, the two did a 10-minute stretch by the riverside bench. Shen Peiwen shared her recent experience adding strength training and demonstrated weighted lunges and banded hip abduction on the spot. Yu Xiaowei followed along for two sets, found them helpful for engaging the glutes and legs, and decided to incorporate them into her own training.

events.name: Go home and search for trail running routes.
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to search online for the trail running routes recommended by Shen Peiwen (such as the first section of the MacLehose Trail), learned about the trail conditions, length, and transportation options, and considered incorporating them into the next phase of her training plan.

events.name: Afternoon family time.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei played with building blocks with her two children at home for a while, and took her daughter to the small park downstairs to swing. Afterward, she followed a video and did a 15-minute core strength workout (plank, bird dog).

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, a workday, Yu Xiaowei handled client matters as usual during the day. In the afternoon, she received a hint from her supervisor Liang Zhenhua about an initial conversation regarding promotion. In the evening, she held the annual family financial planning meeting with her husband. They decided to raise the monthly savings amount and planned to adjust the insurance portfolio, setting the tone for financial health in the new year.

events.name: Organizing the family income and expense details
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei organized the details of the family's full-year income and expenditure for 2024 in her home study, including salary income, daily expenses, insurance premiums, and savings records. She created an electronic spreadsheet to summarize the data, preparing for the financial planning meeting in the evening.

events.name: Supervisor's hint of promotion.
events.description: Before the lunch break, Regional Director Liang Zhenhua called Yu Xiaowei into his office, briefly praised her recent performance, mentioned that the company might have an internal selection opportunity for Regional Deputy Manager, encouraged her to keep up the business momentum, and hinted that he would recommend her. Yu Xiaowei was surprised but greatly encouraged, and said she would redouble her efforts.

events.name: Annual family financial planning meeting
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei held an annual family financial planning meeting with her husband Zhang Weiming in the study. She presented the 2024 income and expenditure statement. After analyzing it, they found that the household savings rate was below their target. They discussed it together and decided to raise the monthly fixed savings amount from HK$5,000 to HK$8,000, and planned to adjust their insurance product portfolio to better balance protection and returns. During the meeting, Yu Xiaowei also raised the idea of going to HSBC in early February to inquire about low-risk wealth management products, and her husband agreed.

events.name: Refining the savings and insurance plan
events.description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei recorded the meeting resolutions in her study, created a new monthly savings plan spreadsheet, specifying that an automatic transfer savings of 8,000 Hong Kong dollars per month would be implemented starting from February 2025, and listed the products she needed to consult the bank about. At the same time, she noted the need to adjust insurance products in her to-do items and planned to communicate with colleagues later.

events.name: Assessing insurance coverage gaps
events.description: Then the two discussed the coverage gaps in the existing insurance products in depth, made a preliminary assessment of the policies, and decided to prioritize adjusting the premium payment period of the education savings insurance and consider adding a term life insurance policy to cover the mortgage risk. They agreed on the adjustment budget and scheduled to organize the specific policy documents together next Monday.

events.name: Evening yoga relaxation
events.description: After the finance meeting, Yu Xiaowei felt stiffness in her shoulders and neck, so she did 15 minutes of Hatha yoga on the living room mat (cat-cow pose, downward dog, child's pose) to relieve the day's fatigue from sitting at a desk.

She also exchanged ideas online with her embroidery friend He Meiling about new creative directions for the Year of the Tiger. In the evening, she bought family ballet performance tickets online in advance, preparing for an art night. Throughout the day she kept her diet lighter, and before bed she did Hatha yoga stretching.

events.name: Morning Hatha yoga stretching
events.description: After getting up at 6:45 a.m., Yu Xiaowei drank warm water on an empty stomach and did a 10-minute Hatha yoga stretch (simplified Sun Salutation sequence) to activate her body and greet the new day.

events.name: Cantonese embroidery 'Peony Painting' meticulously completed.
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei put the finishing stitches on her Cantonese embroidery piece Peony Painting in the study of her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. She examined the stitching on every petal and leaf, making sure the pattern was full and the color transitions were natural. After about two hours of fine refinement, the piece was officially complete.

events.name: Photographing, recording, and organizing tools
events.description: At noon, Yu Xiaowei took multi-angle photos of the completed 'Peony Painting' with her phone on her balcony in natural light, documenting the details and the overall effect. She then carefully put the work into an embroidery storage bag and tidied up her needles, threads, and workbench. For lunch, she made herself a large bowl of vegetable and fruit salad with grilled chicken breast, strictly following the spring nutrition plan.

events.name: Visited her teacher Wu Xiuying.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei took the completed Peony Painting to Lai Chi Kok Road in Sham Shui Po District to visit her teacher Wu Xiuying's Cantonese embroidery studio. Teacher Wu examined it carefully, highly praised the layering and stitching of the peonies, and pointed out a few details that could be improved. The two discussed the work for an hour and a half, and Yu Xiaowei listened carefully to the suggestions.

events.name: Online exchange with fellow embroiderer He Meiling.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei connected via WeChat video with her embroidery friend He Meiling in Shenzhen, showed her the finished photo of the 'Peony Painting' and shared the joy of receiving the teacher's approval. The two then discussed ideas for new works around the Year of the Tiger theme, exchanging views on the composition, color scheme, and stitching techniques of tiger embroidery. The conversation lasted about 40 minutes, and both were enthusiastic about continuing their collaboration.

events.name: Online purchase of ballet performance tickets
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei bought tickets in advance through the Hong Kong Cultural Centre's official website, purchasing four tickets for the family to the Russian Ballet's performance of 'Swan Lake' on January 18. She confirmed the time, seats, and transport route, and communicated the evening arrangements with her husband. Before getting into bed, she also did 5 minutes of relaxing yoga (Butterfly Pose, supine twist) to calm her mood.

During the meal, Zhang Weiming encouraged Yu Xiaowei to push for promotion to deputy manager, while Yu Xiaowei showed concern for her husband's hard work in air-conditioner repair. They also shared amusing stories of their children's growth, and their feelings for each other grew warmer through the conversation.

events.name: Strolling along the Avenue of Stars
events.description: After the meal, they strolled to the nearby Avenue of Stars and walked side by side along the waterfront, enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. The two recalled the time they had held hands there while dating, discussed future family plans and the goal of traveling to Japan, and agreed to schedule at least one date alone every month.

events.name: Go home and rest

After returning home, the whole family had breakfast. Later, Yu Xiaowei led the sorting of seasonal clothes, clearing out old clothes for donation and making space for the new year. During the sorting, they found old photos of her parents, which brought back warm memories. In the afternoon, she took the children to Kowloon Park to play and enjoy the outdoor sunshine. After returning home in the evening, her husband took the initiative to cook, and the family enjoyed a simple dinner together. In the evening, Yu Xiaowei researched cross-border insurance cases to gather material for a sharing session, and before bed, she discussed the Spring Festival spending budget with her husband, ending the day on a warm note.

events.name: Morning run with running partner Shen Peiwen
events.description: At 7 a.m., Yu Xiaowei met her running buddy Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park. The two jogged 10 kilometers at a pace of 6:15 per kilometer. Shen Peiwen shared her plan to take her family to Taiwan during the Spring Festival, while Yu Xiaowei mentioned rumors about changes to the company's organizational structure. They comforted each other as they ran.

events.name: Family breakfast
events.description: After the run, Yu Xiaowei went home and took a shower. Her mother had already cooked plain congee and fried eggs. The family sat down for breakfast, and Yu Xiaowei announced that she would take the children to the park in the afternoon.

events.name: Sorting old clothes and discovering old photos
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei opened the wardrobe and, together with her mother, sorted out several bags of clothes that her children had outgrown and her own old unused garments. After packing them, she put them in the storage room. She came across an old photo album and saw photos of herself with her parents from childhood. Mother and daughter sat on the bedside recalling the past, sighing at how time flies.

events.name: Accompanying children in Kowloon Park
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming took their children to Kowloon Park. The children slid down the slide and swung on the swings at the playground, while Yu Xiaowei sat on a bench reading articles about cross-border insurance policies on her phone, occasionally looking up to capture photos of the children's smiling faces.

events.name: Dinner cooked by her husband
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Zhang Weiming took the initiative to cook and stir-fried two home-style dishes. Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter, her mother Chen Meiling finished feeding the cat, and the family chatted about pre-Spring Festival to-do items during dinner.

events.name: Reading and case accumulation
events.description: At 8:30 pm, Yu Xiaowei browsed insurance industry reports in her study, focusing on collecting cross-border client cases. She copied the policy characteristics of mainland clients such as Wang Qiming and Huang Sheng into her notebook and preliminarily drafted the structure for the March sharing session.

events.name: Family financial discussion
events.description: Before going to bed, Yu Xiaowei and her husband briefly discussed the Spring Festival spending budget in the bedroom. Since they had increased their monthly savings amount, the couple decided to cut back on dining out and shopping expenses, but set aside a special budget for New Year red envelopes.

start_state.mood: Full of energy

2025-01.daily_overview: Today was the day when rumors of organizational restructuring surfaced, casting a shadow over work. In the early morning, Yu Xiaowei went for a morning run in light rain to relieve stress. The weekly meeting in the morning had a calm atmosphere but with underlying restlessness; after the meeting, she continued handling business. During the lunch break, she chatted with Su Lishan and first heard credible news, and her mood instantly became complicated. In the afternoon, she visited a client, Mr. Huang, to review his insurance policy, forcing herself to stay energetic and appear professional, and did not leave until the evening. On the way home, she broke her diet by buying snacks. Once home, she was exhausted but still spent a little time with the children. Late at night, in the study, she wrote down in detail her ideas for team optimization, trying to regain a sense of control amid uncertainty, and did not sleep until the early hours.

events.name: Morning run in the rain.
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, a light rain began to fall. Yu Xiaowei put on her windbreaker and jogged 3 km along Prince Edward Road West. After finishing, she stretched under the eaves, trying to dispel the Monday blues with exercise.

events.name: Weekly team meeting
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei attended the team weekly meeting. Director Liang Zhenhua did not mention the restructuring at all, but the atmosphere in the meeting room was subtle, and there were occasional whispers among colleagues. She pretended to be calm and reported on last week's client signings.

events.name: Caught wind of it during the lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break in the break room, Su Lishan quietly told Yu Xiaowei that she had heard from her close friend in headquarters HR that the company planned to reorganize the sales territories after the Spring Festival, and the current team might be broken up. Yu Xiaowei's heart tightened, feeling that the promotion opportunity within reach was now shrouded in uncertainty.

events.name: Client visit
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei went in the rain to the home of Mr. Wong in the Eastern District of Hong Kong Island to conduct an annual policy review for him. She pulled herself together, explained the terms in detail, and recommended an additional accidental medical insurance plan. Mr. Wong said he would consider it. After leaving, she stood blankly on the street for a moment before coming back to herself.

events.name: Emotional snacking
events.description: On the way home, Yu Xiaowei bought a bag of chips and a box of chocolate bars at a convenience store, eating as she walked. She knew it went against her light diet principles, but she wanted to use sweet and salty flavors to suppress the anxiety in her heart.

events.name: Evening return home and quality time with the kids
events.description: Returned home at 5:30 p.m. Her daughter ran over to show off today's doodles. Yu Xiaowei forced a smile and praised her, then played puzzles with her for ten minutes. Her mother noticed she was in a bad mood and made her a cup of hot tea.

events.name: Evening notes: optimization ideas
events.description: At 9 p.m., after the children had fallen asleep, Yu Xiaowei went into her study, opened a blank document, and began writing down ideas for optimizing the team: splitting the current team of fifteen into three special-purpose groups, adding a mentor system for new hires, and so on. She wrote for nearly an hour, hoping to turn her anxiety into coping strategies.

start_state.mood: Normal

end_state.location: Home study room
end_state.mood: Anxious about the rumor but has started thinking

2025-01.daily_overview: Today was a day of actively seeking the truth. Yu Xiaowei felt anxious in the office, using client proposals as cover for her thoughts, but she kept her ears open for news. In the afternoon, she mustered the courage to meet her supervisor Liang Zhenhua, and got the answer that there was no official notice for now, and was reminded to focus on performance. On the way home after work, she called her husband to pour out her feelings, and his comfort made her feel a little warmer. In the evening, she helped her son finish a science craft project, then did strength training to release stress. Before bed, she browsed industry communities, trying to discern trends from external information, and only managed to fall asleep late at night.

events.name: Working and listening attentively.
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei was at her desk preparing a comprehensive family insurance plan, but she frequently checked the company's internal communication groups and listened in on nearby colleagues' conversations to see if there was any news.

events.name: Meeting with supervisor Liang Zhenhua
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity of reporting client progress to ask tactfully about the organizational restructuring. Liang Zhenhua revealed that it was indeed in the discussion stage, but the official direction had not yet been decided, and he encouraged her to stay steady and let her performance speak.

events.name: Called husband to pour out my feelings.
events.description: On the subway after work, Yu Xiaowei called Zhang Weiming and confided her anxiety about the promotion. Her husband comforted her, telling her to let things take their natural course, that she worked so hard and the company could see it, and suggested that he would take the children for storytime that evening so she could rest.

events.name: Helped son with his homework
events.description: When she got home, Zhang Weiming had already prepared dinner. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei helped Zhang Zixuan complete a small school science project—a simple wind vane. Her son's focused expression made her briefly forget her worries.

events.name: Evening strength training
events.description: At 9 p.m., after the children had gone to sleep, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in the living room and did a 20-minute bodyweight workout: 3 sets of 15 squats, 12 lunges per leg, and 3 sets of 1-minute planks, following the rhythm of an app. After exercising, she felt the tension in her neck and shoulders ease a bit.

events.name: Browsing industry news before bedtime
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei leaned against the headboard and browsed an insurance industry forum on her phone. Seeing an article about trends in optimizing insurance sales teams in the Bay Area, she forwarded it to herself and saved it. She mulled it over repeatedly at night before falling asleep.

start_state.mood: Slight uneasiness

end_state.mood: Anxiety eased slightly, but she was still worried

2025-01.daily_overview: It was a workday of continuously monitoring the organization's activities. Throughout the day, Yu Xiaowei frequently checked emails in the office, used the lunch break to exchange information with colleagues, and also took time to walk by the seaside to get some fresh air. Although she did not catch any official notice, she collected scattered reference clues. By squeezing time into her work, she still managed to complete several customer follow-up calls. In the evening, she dragged her tired body home, deliberately set work aside, and played wholeheartedly with her pet cat Mimi. She held the cat and browsed family photos, letting those warm moments heal her inner restlessness. Before bed, she persisted with 15 minutes of meditation, and finally her mood shifted from anxiety to calm.

events.name: Closely monitoring developments all day
events.description: From the moment she stepped into the office, Yu Xiaowei refreshed her company email and the internal bulletin board every half hour. During the lunch break, she proactively chatted in the break room and heard a rumor from a marketing department colleague that the Zone 3 team might be merged. She immediately noted down the key points on her phone.

events.name: Noon seaside walk
events.description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei did not join her colleagues but walked alone to the seaside promenade near the office. She felt the sea breeze for five minutes, took a few deep breaths, and let her mind go blank for a while.

events.name: Handling client matters
events.description: Despite feeling uneasy, Yu Xiaowei still found time to handle service requests from two clients: she updated the beneficiary information on the family policy for long-time client Mrs. Chen, and returned a call to potential client Mrs. Li, agreeing to meet after the New Year.

events.name: Returning home and setting up the cat play area
events.description: After getting home at 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowei changed into loungewear, set up the cat teaser in the living room, played soft music on her phone, and called "Mimi" over.

events.name: Interacting and playing with the cat
events.description: Yu Xiaowei waved the cat teaser wand, guiding the cat to jump and pounce. Watching its endearingly clumsy appearance, she couldn't help laughing out loud. The 15-minute play session noticeably relieved her accumulated stress.

events.name: Cuddling the cat for comfort and reminiscing over photos
events.description: After playing, she held the cat on her lap and gently stroked its fur, while swiping through the photo album on her phone with the other hand, looking back at recent photos of dates with her husband, her children playing, and her mother cooking. Her heart was soon filled with peace.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: After taking a shower, Yu Xiaowei sat on the edge of the bed and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath to clear away the emotional fragments of the day, then fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Somewhat tight

end_state.mood: Calm and relaxed
