2025-01.daily_overview: Today was the children's last school day before the Spring Festival holiday, and Yu Xiaowei also had the company's year-end review meeting. During the day, she focused on her work and took time to attend the year-end meeting to gauge the team's mood. After the meeting, she proactively spoke briefly to Liang Zhenhua about her desire for promotion. In the afternoon, she had a phone call with Mrs. Chan and got a referral for a new client, which left her visibly pleased. In the evening, after returning home, she checked her son's final report card and praised him, then helped her daughter make handmade firecracker decorations, filling the home with a warm atmosphere. After the children fell asleep, she opened her paper notebook, systematically organized the organizational restructuring information she had gathered over the week, and wrote down three key goals and action steps, turning her vague unease into an actionable plan. She took photos to archive it late at night and gradually felt reassured.

events.name: Attend the company's year-end summary meeting
events.description: At 10 a.m., the year-end meeting for the Wan Chai district of AIA Insurance was held. Director Liang Zhenhua reviewed the year's performance and praised the team's results, but did not mention the restructuring at all. Yu Xiaowei silently speculated from the audience.

events.name: Brief communication with the director after the meeting
events.description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei deliberately waited for Liang Zhenhua in the corridor and expressed her hard work over the past year and her desire to take on more responsibility. Liang Zhenhua nodded and said he would consider it, telling her to keep up her performance.

events.name: Received a referral from a client
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei made a Chinese New Year greeting call to her client Mrs. Chen. Mrs. Chen offered to introduce a colleague to her and arrange a meeting next month. This pleasant surprise lifted her low mood.

events.name: Reviewing son's grades and celebrating.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei looked at her son Zhang Zixuan's end-of-term report card. He got an A in both math and English. She happily picked him up and spun him around, promised to buy him a science model for the Spring Festival, and praised him for working hard.

events.name: Do crafts with daughter.
events.description: After dinner, her daughter took out materials brought back from kindergarten. Yu Xiaowei accompanied her in cutting red paper and making strings of firecrackers, hanging them in the living room to add a festive New Year atmosphere. The sight of her daughter carefully applying glue softened her heart.

events.name: Late-night career planning review
events.description: At 10:30, Yu Xiaowei spread open her career planning notebook in the study and categorized the rumors, colleagues’ opinions, and her own strengths and weaknesses. She wrote down three goals: keep the current team, let results speak for themselves, and prepare applications for backup positions. She also planned a communication schedule, and finally took a photo and saved it to her phone for easy reference at any time.

2025-01.daily_overview: Today was the company's last working day and also the day the family began preparing for the Spring Festival. The children officially started their winter break and were cared for by their mother all day. In the morning, Yu Xiaowei attended the department's final regular meeting, which was filled with a subtle atmosphere of waiting for the restructuring. During the lunch break, she and Su Lishan slipped away to a long-established cha chaan teng for a private talk, exchanging information and encouraging each other, then went to the mall to look at new clothes but without success. In the afternoon, she finally began organizing cross-border insurance cases, laying out the framework for the Shenzhen sharing session. In the evening, she returned home and finalized with her mother the next day's cleaning assignments and the Chinese New Year shopping list. At night, she continued collecting client proposals, and before going to bed drafted several pages of a sharing outline, welcoming the prelude to Xiaonian with a sense of fulfillment.

events.name: Morning department meeting
events.description: At 9 a.m., the team held its last meeting before the holiday, exchanging early New Year greetings, but there was still curiosity in their eyes. Liang Zhenhua calmly said, "There may be some new measures after the New Year; everyone enjoy the holiday." Yu Xiaowei took that sentence to heart.

events.name: A private chat with Su Lishan at a cha chaan teng.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei met Su Lishan at the Kam Fung Café next to the company. They ordered two cups of milk tea and, away from the office, exchanged the latest rumors they had heard about the department merger. Su Lishan also brought bits of information from other teams, and the two agreed to keep each other informed immediately if anything new came up.

events.name: Browsing the mall for Chinese New Year clothes
events.description: After the tea restaurant, the two turned into a nearby shopping mall and quickly browsed a few clothing stores. Yu Xiaowei wanted to buy new red outfits for the whole family for the New Year, but she didn't find any satisfactory styles and decided to go again another day.

events.name: Start organizing cross-border cases
events.description: Returning to the office at 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowei opened the database, pulled up cross-border client files such as Wang Qiming and Huang Sheng, extracted the allocation logic for education funds and high-end medical insurance, and worked on the three-act structure of the sharing session—"case introduction, needs analysis, product matching"—until the end of the workday.

events.name: Making spring cleaning and Lunar New Year shopping plans with my mother
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her mother checked the notice board in the living room and listed the steps for tomorrow's big cleaning: Yu Xiaowei would wipe down the kitchen and furniture, her husband would mop the floors and clean the windows, her mother would tidy up odds and ends, her son would organize his toys, and her daughter would water the flowers. They also wrote down the shopping list for the Mong Kok street market: Spring Festival couplets, fortune characters, New Year cakes, Chinese sausages, dried scallops, and more.

events.name: Continue preparing materials in the evening
events.description: At 9 p.m., after the children were asleep, Yu Xiaowei went back to the study to further refine the cross-border product portfolio—bundling high-end medical and savings insurance—and wrote up supporting sales talking points, working until 11 p.m.

In the afternoon, they put up brand-new Spring Festival couplets and fu characters, instantly filling the home with New Year atmosphere. Amid the busy work, Yu Xiaowei remembered to wrap the Cantonese embroidered handkerchiefs as gifts for her close friends and squeezed in time to research cross-border insurance portfolios. While cleaning, she found the love letter her husband had written years ago, sparking warm teasing between the couple. In the morning, she had also taken her daughter to ballet class. In the evening, the family sat together, looking at the renewed home and enjoying the satisfaction of their labor. Though their bodies ached, their hearts were filled with the joy of bidding farewell to the old year and welcoming the new.

events.name: Wrap the Cantonese embroidery gift
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowei carefully folded the embroidered handkerchief in her study, wrapped it in off-white silk paper, tied it with a deep red ribbon into a ruyi knot, placed it in an elegant paper bag, and prepared to give it to Lin Jiaxin tomorrow.

events.name: Take daughter to ballet class.
events.description: At 8:45 a.m., Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the dance studio in Kowloon Tong for a 9:00-9:45 ballet class. After class, she picked up her daughter, and the whole family started a general cleaning around 10:00.

events.name: Family spring cleaning and discovering a love letter
events.description: Starting at 10:00, the whole family acted according to the plan: Yu Xiaowei put on gloves and cleaned the range hood and refrigerator; her husband Zhang Weiming mopped the living room and bedroom; her mother tidied the storage room and washed the bed sheets; Zhang Zixuan sorted his toys into boxes; and Zhang Yuxin carried a small watering can to water the plants on the windowsill. While cleaning the bookcase, a letter Zhang Weiming had written when they were dating fell out of an old book. The couple laughed and relived the memory, while the children watched curiously.

events.name: Pasting Spring Festival couplets and the "Fu" character
events.description: At 3 p.m., Zhang Weiming brought out a ladder, Yu Xiaowei handed him spring couplets and tape, and they pasted on the front door the couplet "Fortune Star Shines Bright on a Peaceful House". On each room door, the character "Fu" was pasted upside down. The bright red decorations gave the old house a fresh look.

events.name: Continue researching cross-border insurance portfolios.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., during her break, Yu Xiaowei opened her laptop in the living room and put together a standard package of “high-end medical + savings insurance + accident insurance” for Hong Kong residents stationed in Shenzhen, and recorded the fee comparison. She plans to have an in-depth discussion with Wang Qiming after the holiday.

events.name: Small family celebration in the evening
events.description: After dinner, the family sat in the tidy living room. Mother cooked tangyuan. Yu Xiaowei smiled and announced that tomorrow there would be a gathering with her close girlfriends and New Year shopping, and proposed that the whole family go to the movies on the first day of the Lunar New Year, which was met with unanimous agreement.

2025-01.daily_overview: Today was the last rest day before the Lunar New Year, centered on best-friend bonding and a big pre-holiday shopping trip. In the morning, she spent leisurely time with her family. In the afternoon, she and Lin Jiaxin cozied up in a Kowloon City coffee shop, exchanged carefully prepared gifts, caught up on each other's news, and agreed on a post-holiday parent-child outing. Then she and her mother rushed to the Mong Kok street market for a major stock-up and came home loaded with New Year goods; the fridge was finally full. In the evening, she used the quiet time to browse industry reports to stay professionally sharp. However, overspending sparked a small argument with her husband, but they quickly made up. Everything is ready, just waiting for the New Year.

events.name: Weekend lie-in and family breakfast
events.description: Yu Xiaowei slept until 8 o'clock. After getting up, she had breakfast with her family in the living room: rice rolls made by her mother. Her son showed off the results of tidying his room the day before, and her daughter handed her a drawing she had made of the 'big clean-up'.

events.name: Going to a coffee date with a close friend
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei walked to a coffee shop she often went to near Prince Edward Road West. Lin Jiaxin had already arrived. The two ordered hot lattes and exchanged gifts: Xiaowei gave a Cantonese embroidered handkerchief, and Jiaxin gave a wooden aromatherapy gift box in return. Then they chatted about amusing moments in each other's families over the past month and set February 15 as the date to take their children to Disneyland together.

events.name: Big New Year shopping trip.
events.description: At 4:30 pm, Yu Xiaowei returned home to pick up her mother, then took the MTR to Mong Kok Market. Weaving through the stalls, they bought coconut New Year cakes, turnip cakes, Chinese sausages, shiitake mushrooms, and black moss, then chose peach blossoms and gladioli at the flower stall. Finally, they picked up two packs of red envelopes on the way, took a taxi home laden with bags, spending about HK$4,200 in total.

events.name: Organize Chinese New Year supplies and the refrigerator
events.description: Back home, Yu Xiaowei and her mother packed the ingredients into separate containers and refrigerated them, placed the New Year flowers in vases and put them in the living room, set the gladioli by the window, and put the peach blossoms on the coffee table. The room instantly became full of life.

events.name: A small argument over budget overrun and making up
events.description: After dinner, Zhang Weiming frowned at the purchasing bill and muttered, "It's over the original plan by 600." Yu Xiaowei initially defended herself, and their voices gradually rose, but a few minutes later she sighed and said, "I wasn't restrained enough." Zhang Weiming also softened, and the two worked together to allocate an additional 5,000 yuan for the Spring Festival.

events.name: Browsing industry reports
events.description: At 9 pm, Yu Xiaowei reviewed the Greater Bay Area insurance quarterly report sent by the insurance company in her study, paying special attention to 2024 cross-border policy growth data and 2025 policy forecasts, and saved excerpts into the materials folder for the sharing session.

events.name: Final office tasks before the holiday

The office was filled with a relaxed pre-holiday atmosphere.

events.name: Finalizing the career adjustment plan.

events.name: Strolling through the Lunar New Year flower market

Her father Yu Guoqiang told Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin that kumquats symbolize good luck and good fortune, and narcissus symbolizes family reunion. Yu Xiaowei bought two pots of narcissus and a peach blossom branch, Zhang Weiming chose gladioli, and the children excitedly carried small lantern-shaped toys.

events.name: Arranging Lunar New Year flowers and vases
events.description: The whole family worked together to arrange the newly bought flowers. The narcissus was placed next to the TV cabinet, and the gladioli and peach blossoms were paired with the flowers purchased yesterday. When Zhang Zixuan was helping pass a vase, his feet slipped and he broke an old porcelain vase. Yu Xiaowei quickly checked to see if the child was cut, and after confirming he was safe, she pretended to be angry but was soon amused by the child's apology, and they cleaned up the fragments together.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Chinese New Year's Eve, from buying high-protein ingredients in the early morning to stock up for post-holiday training, to the whole family gathering in the kitchen to help in the afternoon, three generations were lively together. Mother-in-law Li Shufen came from Kwun Tong, mother Chen Meiling did the main cooking, Yu Xiaowei helped, and her husband was in charge of setting the table. During that time, Yu Xiaowei accidentally cut her finger while chopping vegetables, but after a simple bandage she continued working. In the evening, they paid respects to their ancestors on time, then enjoyed dishes with auspicious meanings such as roast meat combo, fat choy and dried oysters, and steamed grouper. Laughter filled the room, and the elders gave red envelopes to the children. After the meal, they went near the neighborhood to watch residents set off fireworks, then returned home to gather around the TV to watch the Spring Festival Gala. At midnight, after exchanging New Year greetings, the adults gradually cleaned up and went to bed. The feeling of family reunion at Spring Festival filled every corner.

events.name: Shopping for high-protein ingredients
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., to support her post-holiday training, Yu Xiaowei made a special trip to Hau Wong Road Market to buy chicken breast, salmon fillets, eggs, broccoli, and more. She also went to the supermarket to stock up on Greek yogurt and oats. After returning home, she portioned and froze them to store energy for marathon preparation.

events.name: The whole family prepares the New Year's Eve dinner, and an accidental cut occurs.
events.description: Starting at noon, her mother Chen Meiling cooked, her father Yu Guoqiang helped wash vegetables, Yu Xiaowei cut cured meat and mixed sauces, and Zhang Weiming set the table. After her mother-in-law Li Shufen arrived, she joined in making dumplings. While slicing lotus root, Yu Xiaowei accidentally cut her index finger. Her mother quickly found a band-aid. She smiled and said, 'Seeing blood is a good sign — red fortune is coming,' and continued working.

events.name: New Year's Eve reunion dinner
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., after paying respects to the ancestors, dinner began. The table was filled with delicacies: honey-glazed char siu, roasted goose combination platter, wonton noodles, steamed fish, and more. Yu Xiaowei served food to the elders first. During the meal, her husband raised a toast to thank her for her efforts over the year. Her father Yu Guoqiang jokingly told him to drink less, and everyone laughed. Her mother-in-law and mother gave the grandchildren lucky money.

events.name: Chinese New Year's Eve vigil and fireworks
events.description: After dinner, the whole family moved to the open area of the estate garden to watch neighbors set off small fireworks. The brilliant flashes lit up the family's smiling faces. After returning home at 9, they sat on the sofa watching the Chinese New Year Gala. The children stayed up until 12, excitedly shouting "Happy New Year" to each other. The adults stayed up until nearly 1 a.m. for the New Year vigil.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Excited and expectant

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Immense happiness and gratitude after the family reunion

state.daily_exercise: Housework, helping in the kitchen, and a walk

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of the Lunar New Year, following tradition, she got up early and ate a vegetarian meal. Then the whole family went in high spirits to Wong Tai Sin Temple to pray, and amid the sea of people sincerely wished for smooth careers and family health in the new year. After drawing fortune sticks, she unexpectedly ran into her old classmate Wang Zhiyuan and exchanged greetings and blessings. At noon, they went to Golden Bridge Building in Kwun Tong, where her mother-in-law Li Shufen lived, to pay New Year visits to her and the neighbors, and tasted the New Year cake her mother-in-law had made by hand. In the afternoon, the children played in the downstairs garden while Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother-in-law, listening to her talk about New Year customs from her youth. In the evening, they returned to their home on Prince Edward Road West. Though tired, she felt cheerful. After a simple family dinner, they watched a special Chinese New Year TV program and planned how to host her younger brother's family the next day.

events.name: Lunar New Year's Day Breakfast and Departure for Blessings
events.description: At 8 a.m., after the family had eaten vegetarian noodles, they changed into Chinese-style padded jackets and took a private car to Wong Tai Sin Temple. The grounds were crowded with people. Yu Xiaowei took her children and squeezed through the crowd to the incense burner to offer incense, silently making wishes for career and family.

events.name: Praying at Wong Tai Sin Temple and running into a classmate
events.description: In the main hall, Yu Xiaowei knelt down to draw a fortune stick and got a medium-fortune stick. The fortune teller said, 'Sow in spring, harvest in autumn; be patient and wait.' As she stood up, she unexpectedly saw her high school classmate Wang Zhiyuan also waiting in line. The two greeted each other with surprise, exchanged red envelopes, and wished each other a happy new year.

events.name: Paying a New Year's visit to mother-in-law's home
events.description: At 2:00 p.m., the family arrived at her mother-in-law's home on Hong Ning Road in Kwun Tong. Her mother-in-law, Li Shufen, greeted them in a dark red cotton-padded jacket. Yu Xiaowei handed red envelopes to the elders, and the children said in unison, 'Happy New Year, Grandma!' Neighbors came over to visit, and her mother-in-law proudly introduced her daughter-in-law as an elite insurance professional. Her mother-in-law brought out turnip cake and fried taro and shrimp fritters, and everyone chatted while eating.

events.name: Return home in the evening and rest
events.description: At 5 p.m., the group returned to Kowloon City. On the way, Yu Xiaowei received a message from her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng confirming that he would arrive at West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station at 10 a.m. the next day. She immediately replied that she would go to meet him. At 9 p.m., carrying the day's liveliness and slight fatigue, the whole family went to bed early.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Radiant with joy

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Contentment and slight fatigue after the celebration.

state.daily_exercise: Walking at the temple: about 8,000 steps

2025-01.daily_overview: Today is the second day of the Lunar New Year, the day for married women to return to their parents' home, and also an important moment for her younger brother's family to return to Hong Kong from Shenzhen for a reunion. In the morning, Yu Xiaowei and her husband went to West Kowloon Station to welcome them. The children were thrilled to see their younger cousin. After returning home for a short rest, the two families visited the Victoria Park Lunar New Year flower market in the afternoon, strolling and chatting among the sea of flowers. In the evening, they returned home, and her mother and her younger brother's wife cooked dinner together, with a table full of dishes even better than New Year's Eve. During the meal, the siblings caught up and discussed sharing travel expenses, with laughter and joy. After dinner, the two families sat around playing board games in a lively atmosphere. At night, they dug out unused dumbbells and a yoga mat, and made plans with running friends to train together after the holiday, injecting new exercise motivation into life.

events.name: Pick up her younger brother and his family.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowei, Zhang Weiming, and their son went to West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station holding a sign to welcome Yu Xiaofeng's family of three. After greeting and hugging, Xiaofeng handed over gifts brought from Shenzhen — tea and children's educational toys.

events.name: Enjoying New Year flowers at Victoria Park.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the two families, along with Chen Meiling and Yu Guoqiang, took a taxi to the Victoria Park Lunar New Year market in Wan Chai. The stalls were full of colorful flowers, and the children kept spinning windmills at the windmill stalls. Yu Xiaowei bought a few branches of silver willow. Her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng brought up the Japan travel expenses she had been worried about and said they could share the hotel costs. Xiaowei was touched and nodded.

events.name: Family dinner and board game night
events.description: In the evening, mother Chen Meiling and sister-in-law Zhao Min teamed up to cook a table of good dishes, including ginger-and-scallion stir-fried crab and soy sauce chicken. After dinner, the children played with new toys in the living room, while the adults sat around playing Monopoly. Xiaofeng and Weiming kept bickering, and laughter filled the room.

events.name: Organizing workout gear
events.description: At 8 p.m., while her younger brother's family was watching the Spring Festival Gala replay in the living room, Yu Xiaowei went to the storage room alone, found the dusty dumbbells and yoga mat, and carefully wiped them. She checked the soles of her running shoes and found little wear, so she took a photo and sent it to Shen Peiwen to arrange a morning run on February 1. Shen Peiwen instantly replied, "Great!"

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: The joy of looking forward to gathering together

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: A sense of fulfillment after the family reunion and anticipation of getting back to exercise.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 10,000 steps at the flower market.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the third day of the Lunar New Year, the 'Red Mouth' day when traditionally no New Year visits are made, Yu Xiaowei nevertheless took the children to her close friend Lin Jiaxin's home in Sham Shui Po as agreed; it was a relaxed girls' time. In the morning she saw off her brother's family, tidied up a little, and completed an easy morning run. In the afternoon at the Lins' home, the children played together while she and Jiaxin hid in the kitchen, snacking on laughing cookies and talking heart to heart. They also tried making cookies and failed, but had fun. In the evening they headed home, took a seaside walk with the family, and after arriving home she quietly wound down, reviewing her route to work and to-do list for the next day. The festive joy of the Spring Festival slowly settled into the calm of routine, bringing this lively and tightly packed Lunar New Year holiday to a satisfying close.

events.name: Easy morning run
events.description: At 7 a.m., while her family was still asleep, Yu Xiaowei put on her running shoes and jogged 3 kilometers around the neighborhood at a pace of about 7:10 per kilometer, taking it easy and not chasing speed, with simple stretches afterward.

events.name: See off younger brother and rest in the morning.
events.description: At 9 a.m., after accompanying her younger brother's family to have morning tea at a nearby restaurant, Yu Xiaowei saw them off at Prince Edward MTR Station and watched them begin their journey back to Shenzhen. After returning home, she and her mother tidied the guest room, put the toys away, and washed the sheets.

events.name: Paying a New Year's visit to Lin Jiaxin's home
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei asked her husband to stay home and play chess with her father, and took her son and daughter by MTR to Sham Shui Po. When Lin Jiaxin opened the door wearing an apron, she brought out fried smiling sesame balls and sugar rings. The children immediately dove into building-block games with Jiaxin's daughter.

events.name: Chatting with besties and a baking failure story.
events.description: Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin sat by the sofa and talked for a full two hours, from red packet amounts to office gossip. Then on a whim they tried making cookies, but mistook salt for sugar. The baked cookies were salty and bitter; after one bite, they looked at each other and burst out laughing.

events.name: Returned home and took a walk with the family
events.description: When she got home at 6 p.m., Zhang Weiming had already reheated the dinner left by his mother. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei suggested the whole family go for a walk on the waterfront promenade. The family of four walked and chatted along the way; her daughter rode a small bike, and her son collected seashells. The walk took 40 minutes.

events.name: Minggang preparation work
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei opened the calendar on her phone, confirmed that the office would reopen tomorrow (February 1), scheduled an internal meeting at 9:00 a.m., and set an alarm. She took one last look at her sleeping family and then fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Light and cheerful

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: The peace after the holiday ends and a level-headed attitude toward tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run: 3 km. Family walk: 40 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with local showers in the afternoon

2025-09.daily_overview: On the first day of school, the family routine got back on track. After a light morning jog, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother prepare meals. The daytime work pace was intense, and in the evening she devoted herself to interval running training and the CFP study plan, feeling for the first time the mechanical nature of training.

events.name: Morning run and school drop-off on the first day of school
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei jogged along Prince Edward Road West to Kowloon Tsai Park, completing a 2-kilometer easy run as a wake-up. She then returned home to wash up and helped her mother prepare the children's first-day-of-school breakfast. At 7:20 she and her husband took the children to the school gate.

events.name: Midday eye yoga and CFP online course
events.description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowei did 5 minutes of eye yoga at her desk, then listened to an online introductory course on the CFP investment planning module while eating her homemade sandwich, preparing to make a systematic plan for the evening.

events.name: Develop a CFP study plan
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., back in her home study, based on the November exam schedule, Yu Xiaowei divided September into three phases: foundation consolidation, breakthrough of difficult points, and mock exam sprint. She set clear weekly learning goals and planned to listen to online courses during daily commutes and do notes and practice exercises in the evenings. She posted the plan on the whiteboard in her study.

events.name: Interval running training and early signs of detachment
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei went alone to Kowloon Tsai Sports Ground for 400m x 10 interval runs, sprinting each set at 85% of maximum heart rate with slow jogging recovery between sets. By the end of the workout, her pace had recovered, but the mechanical repetition suddenly gave her a sense of detachment, as if running had become nothing but chasing numbers.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and eye yoga
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei completed 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation and a second session of eye yoga to help relieve physical and mental fatigue.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: A little nervous about the new semester's pace but full of anticipation

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: The exhaustion and sense of accomplishment after training intertwined, with a slight confusion about the feeling of detachment.

state.daily_exercise: Morning 2 km jog (5:30-6:00), evening interval running 400 m × 10 sets (about 60 minutes), 15-minute meditation before bed.

2025-09.daily_overview: The workday remained as busy as ever. Yu Xiaowei got up early to attend morning yoga class, studied on her commute, exchanged CFP insights with colleagues at noon, and followed her plan in the evening. It was balanced overall.

events.name: Morning Ashtanga yoga practice
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei walked to the community yoga center and attended the 7:00-8:00 Ashtanga morning class, focusing on breath and strength balance. After class, she felt relaxed in body and mind. After returning home, she quickly washed up, had breakfast, took her child to school, and then commuted.

events.name: CFP online course on the commute and midday exchange
events.description: On the commute on the metro, Yu Xiaowei listened to the latter half of the first lesson of the CFP investment planning online course, focusing on recording asset allocation categories. During the lunch break, she had lunch with her colleague Su Lishan at Tsui Wah Restaurant and discussed CFP study progress. Su Lishan shared her experience of integrating theory into client retirement planning, and Yu Xiaowei was inspired.

events.name: Evening study and parent-child time
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei first helped her children finish their homework. After the children fell asleep, she entered the study at 21:30, organized the notes from the day's online course, and completed 15 practice questions in the investment planning module. During a break, she did the second session of eye yoga. She studied until 22:45, then did 10 minutes of yoga stretching before going to sleep.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: Slightly tired, but felt refreshed after the yoga class.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: Encouraged by the lunch exchange, more confident in CFP study

2025-09.daily_overview: Yu Xiaowei went to Shenzhen to close a deal with a client, achieving a cross-border business breakthrough, but her supervisor's reminder made her realize the importance of balancing Hong Kong's local business. After a busy day, an evening video stretching session eased her fatigue.

events.name: Morning run and departure preparations.
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei went for an easy 3 km morning run. After getting home, she quickly washed up and had breakfast, then checked the document folder for Wang Qiming's high-end medical insurance contract prepared the day before. She changed into a light gray professional suit skirt and confirmed the details of the afternoon meeting with Wang Qiming in advance via WeChat.

events.name: Shenzhen trip to sign the deal
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., she set off from the office, took the MTR to Lo Wu, crossed the border, arrived in Shenzhen around 11:30, transferred to the subway to the Science Park in Nanshan District, and reached the Starbucks near Wang Qiming's company at 12:30. Yu Xiaowei explained the policy terms item by item and patiently answered his concerns about the pre-existing condition clause. Wang Qiming signed on the spot. The two took a photo together as a memento, and Yu Xiaowei thanked him for his trust and promised follow-up service.

events.name: Report to the supervisor with a subtle reminder.
events.description: At 4:00 p.m. she returned to Hong Kong and went directly to the AIA Building in Wan Chai to report the details to team director Liang Zhenhua. Liang Zhenhua praised the breakthrough in expanding the Shenzhen market, but then pointedly reminded her that Hong Kong is the foundation. Yu Xiaowei's heart sank slightly, and she decided to strengthen the maintenance of local clients.

events.name: Evening video stretching session
events.description: At 9:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her running buddy Shen Peiwen did 30 minutes of dynamic stretching via WeChat video. She shared her achievement of signing the contract in Shenzhen and her supervisor's reminder. Shen Peiwen encouraged her to keep her pace. Yu Xiaowei also confirmed the meeting time and route for Sunday's LSD.

events.name: Family sharing time and getting ready for bed.
events.description: Briefly shared her feelings about the contract signing and her supervisor’s reminder with her husband Zhang Weiming. Zhang Weiming comforted her and told her to adjust slowly. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowei did eye yoga and 15 minutes of meditation. Feeling a little tired from the day’s rushing around, she went to bed a bit later.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: Filled with anticipation but also somewhat stressed about the Shenzhen signing

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: The sense of accomplishment from signing the contract was mixed with the hidden worry brought by the supervisor's reminder, and I thought about how to balance business between the two places.

state.daily_exercise: Morning 3 km jog (5:30-6:00), evening video stretching for 30 minutes, and meditation for 15 minutes.

2025-09.daily_overview: The workday continued. After early-morning yoga, Yu Xiaowei handled work. During an easy run in the evening, she again experienced a sense of detachment. After studying at night, she poured out her feelings through her diary.

events.name: Morning Ashtanga yoga practice
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei attended the community morning yoga class again. The teacher gave special guidance on hip-opening sequences to help relieve morning stiffness. After class, she felt calm.

events.name: Midday Study and Client Communication
events.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowei ate a sandwich at her desk and listened to the risk management chapter of the CFP online course. Afterwards, she called her high-net-worth client Chen Meiling to confirm the visit time next Tuesday. Mrs. Chen warmly invited her to taste the soup she had made. At the same time, she did her first eye yoga.

events.name: Evening easy run and the recurrence of that detached feeling
events.description: At 7:30 in the evening, Yu Xiaowei changed into sportswear and jogged along Prince Edward Road West to Fa Hui Park, completing an easy 5 km run with her heart rate kept in the aerobic zone. Passing the flower market on the way, she saw colorful flowers, yet couldn't shake a sense of alienation from the mechanical repetition. She sat on a park bench and asked herself: What is the meaning of training?

events.name: Evening study and reflection journal
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei completed the day's CFP question bank training (20 questions) in the study, with an accuracy rate of 78%, and marked the knowledge points of the wrong questions. Then, in her training diary, she wrote about the emotional ups and downs of running and decided to talk to her coach over the weekend. Before bed, she completed the second session of eye yoga and 10 minutes of meditation.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: Slightly tired on waking, but refreshed after yoga

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: She began to have doubts about rote training, but felt relieved by confiding in her diary.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Friday, after receiving a large commission, Yu Xiaowei efficiently allocated the family finances and set aside a budget for training gear for herself. After an easy run in the evening, she briefly discussed finances with her husband.

events.name: Morning easy run and learning during the commute
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei went for an easy 3 km run at a 6:20/km pace, keeping it relaxed. During her subway commute, she spent 50 minutes listening to an online CFP portfolio management chapter and gained a framework-level understanding of risk asset allocation weight calculation.

events.name: Commission credited and verified
events.description: In the morning at the office, Yu Xiaowei saw a notice about the first September commission and the performance bonus for the Shenzhen high-end medical insurance, totaling 58,000 Hong Kong dollars. She used the mobile banking app to confirm that the funds had arrived, feeling delighted.

events.name: Family financial allocation and communication.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei transferred 30,000 Hong Kong dollars from her personal account to the family savings account, set aside 20,000 Hong Kong dollars for the children's extracurricular class fees, and allocated 8,000 Hong Kong dollars for personal spending and a budget to update her running shoes and sports watch. She told her husband Zhang Weiming about the plan, and the two confirmed the September spending arrangements.

events.name: Evening yoga and meditation
events.description: After finishing the financial arrangements, Yu Xiaowei did a 30-minute vinyasa flow yoga session in the living room, focusing on stretching her legs and hips to prepare for Sunday's LSD. Then she completed a 15-minute mindfulness meditation and eye yoga.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: Looking forward to payday, feeling relaxed.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: Financial arrangements were in order, and she felt at ease about the increased family savings.

2025-09.daily_overview: After her self-directed long run on Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowei hurried to the Cantonese embroidery studio, where she unexpectedly received an invitation from teacher Wu Xiuying to co-run the studio. This trust made her feel both honored and responsible. That night, after discussing it with her husband, she fell into deep thought.

events.name: Self-directed long-distance training run
events.description: At 5:00 in the morning, because her coach, Zhao Zhiming, had been invited to Shanghai on short notice to attend a marathon training seminar and could not provide on-site guidance this week, Yu Xiaowei followed the remote training plan he had sent the night before and went alone to the Tseung Kwan O Waterfront Promenade for a 16-kilometer long-distance training run, completing the entire distance at a steady marathon pace. While stretching after the run, the sea breeze and morning view blurred, and a feeling of emptiness washed over her. She decided to confide in Teacher Wu during the afternoon break.

events.name: Head to the Cantonese embroidery studio
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., after going home to take a shower and having a simple breakfast, Yu Xiaowei took her embroidery tools and materials and took the MTR to Wu Xiuying's Cantonese Embroidery Studio at No. 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, and bought egg tarts from an old shop on the corner as a gift for her teacher.

events.name: Cantonese embroidery class and Teacher Wu's dizziness
events.description: In the afternoon class, Yu Xiaowei and her embroidery friend He Meiling learned the 'Goldfish' stitch of Cantonese embroidery. During the break, Teacher Wu Xiuying suddenly felt dizzy from low blood sugar. Yu Xiaowei and He Meiling immediately helped her to the sofa to rest, fed her sugar water, and wiped her sweat. The teacher gradually recovered.

events.name: Organize the studio and partnership invitations
events.description: During Teacher Wu's break, Yu Xiaowei and He Meiling took the initiative to tidy up the studio: putting away silk threads, cleaning the table tops, arranging the embroidery frames, and sweeping the floor. Teacher Wu was deeply moved and formally expressed the hope that they would jointly run the Cantonese embroidery studio in the future and pass on the craft. Yu Xiaowei was deeply touched by this trust, but also realized she needed to consider it carefully.

events.name: Returning home and late-night talk between the couple.
events.description: After the class ended, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to He Meiling and took the MTR home. In the evening, in the bedroom, she told her husband in detail about the studio invitation, and the two analyzed the time, energy, and financial impact involved in running it. Zhang Weiming expressed support but reminded her to balance her main career and family. Yu Xiaowei nodded and decided to discuss the plan with He Meiling first. Before bed, she completed meditation and eye yoga.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: Woke up with a start and prepared for a long run, feeling slightly tired but looking forward to it

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: Moved by the teacher's entrustment, she felt a sense of mission to carry it on, and also a bit weighed down by the responsibility.

events.name: Easy recovery morning run.

After the run, she took her family to a nearby teahouse for morning tea, enjoying the weekend morning sunshine.

events.name: Shopping and afternoon tea in Causeway Bay
events.description: At 2:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei met her childhood friend Lin Jiaxin at Times Square. The two tried on new autumn clothes and shared funny stories about raising their children. Afterwards, they had mille crêpe cake and Earl Grey tea at Lady M. Yu Xiaowei confided her vague worries that her Shenzhen friends Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi might be betraying her—she always felt they were hiding something. Lin Jiaxin reassured her not to be overly suspicious and suggested she observe first.

events.name: Family movie night
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei watched a Disney movie with her husband and children, sharing low-fat popcorn and juice and enjoying family time together, temporarily putting aside the doubts about her friend. Before bed, she did eye yoga and meditation.

2025-09.daily_overview: At the start of the new week, after her morning run, Yu Xiaowei discussed the future of the studio with He Meiling, and at noon discussed CFP difficulties with Su Lishan. In the evening, an interval run again triggered a sense of detachment, so she made an appointment to talk with her coach.

events.name: Morning jog and video conference
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, she ran 3 kilometers. After returning home, Yu Xiaowei had a video call with He Meiling on WeChat. They both agreed that taking over Teacher Wu's studio was a valuable opportunity to carry on Cantonese embroidery, and they had an initial discussion about the division of work: He Meiling would be in charge of course design, and Yu Xiaowei would handle external liaison and market development. They agreed to discuss the details with Teacher Wu over the weekend.

events.name: Midday lunch with Su Lishan.
events.description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowei met Su Lishan again at a cha chaan teng, focusing on the difficult points in asset allocation in the CFP investment module — dynamic rebalancing and factor strategies. Su Lishan shared client cases to help Yu Xiaowei clarify her thinking, and she decided to tackle this part in the evening.

events.name: Kowloon Bay interval run.
events.description: At 7:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei went to Kowloon Bay Sports Ground for a 400m x 10 interval run, sprinting all out for each set with jogging recovery in between. After training, the feeling of detachment hit her again, and she sat by the track asking herself over and over why she started training. She took a photo of the track at sunset and sent it to her coach Zhao Zhiming with the message: Coach, can we talk this weekend?

events.name: Evening study and emotional processing
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei completed a CFP question bank training session (15 questions) in her study, and her accuracy rate rose to 85%. But she was still preoccupied with the training. Opening her running journal, she wrote, “Maybe I should rediscover the pure joy of my first half marathon.” Before bed, she did eye yoga and meditation.

2025-09.daily_overview: After doing early-morning yoga, Yu Xiaowei successfully completed the annual policy reviews and new policy signings for existing clients, performing professionally. In the evening, she overcame drowsiness and kept studying, advancing both work and exam preparation.

events.name: Ashtanga yoga morning practice and client preparation.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei attended an early yoga class. The teacher emphasized "bringing breath into the poses," which helped relieve morning stiffness. On the commute back, she reviewed Chen Meiling's family policy file, highlighted the children's education fund gap and the sufficiency of coverage, and organized comparison charts.

events.name: Visit client Chen Meiling to sign the contract.

During the nutritious breakfast prepared by my husband Zhang Weiming, we discussed family topics. I studied for CFP whenever I could during commuting and lunch breaks. In the afternoon, I handled conflicts from team restructuring; in the evening, I cleaned the storage room; and small disputes at my daughter's kindergarten took a bit of my energy here and there.

events.name: Preparing breakfast for training day in the early morning.
events.description: At 5:45 in the morning on September 16, 2025, Yu Xiaowei's husband Zhang Weiming was busy in the kitchen of their home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District. He put into practice what he had learned from the nutrition course, carefully cooking a breakfast high in protein and low on the glycemic index: pan-fried chicken breast slowly cooked with a little olive oil until golden on both sides, seasoned with black pepper and sea salt; boiled eggs cooked in boiling water for 7 minutes to a soft-boiled state; whole wheat toast toasted in the toaster until slightly crispy; and freshly ground unsweetened soy milk made with a soy milk maker. He carefully controlled the heat and portions of each step, hoping to provide precise energy for his wife's training that day, unaware that she had decided to sleep in a little longer.

events.name: Couple having breakfast together and talking
events.description: At about 6:15, Yu Xiaowei got up and sat facing her husband as they enjoyed breakfast. Zhang Weiming, while cutting chicken breast, seriously mentioned his idea of switching to nutrition and obtaining a public nutritionist qualification. Yu Xiaowei asked in detail about the course schedule and exam requirements, and proactively said the family could cover the costs. The conversation then turned to their daughter Zhang Yuxin. Zhang Weiming imitated their daughter's clumsy but earnest way of learning ballet, making her laugh heartily. She felt family warmth, but a trace of guilt flickered through her mind over giving up her morning exercise.

events.name: Handled a small dispute involving her daughter during the noon break
events.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowei received a call from her daughter's kindergarten teacher and learned that Zhang Yuxin had been pushed down by a child while playing, leaving her knee slightly red. She immediately contacted her husband and asked him to pick up their daughter early in the afternoon, and also asked the teacher to keep an extra eye on her. After hanging up, she sighed softly, quickly took a few bites of lunch, and continued her CFP study.

events.name: Discuss weekend arrangements for the children

events.name: Fragmented learning during commutes and lunch breaks
events.description: On Tuesday morning during her commute, Yu Xiaowei listened to the 'Portfolio Rebalancing' section of a CFP online course on the MTR East Rail line and jotted down the formulas in her phone notes. During lunch break, she quickly reviewed 10 minutes of wrong questions in the pantry and flipped through printed materials. After returning home in the evening, she completed a 40-minute targeted practice on high-frequency wrong questions in the study, solving 20 questions, and drew a mind map of the asset allocation process. Her total CFP study time that day was about 1 hour.

events.name: Conflicts and clarification in team responsibility restructuring
events.description: All day on September 16, 2025, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan entered the responsibilities and project assignments of the team's eight members one by one into Excel in the AIA meeting room and generated workload proportion charts. The data clearly showed an imbalance in which newcomers handled trivial tasks while veteran employees held on to high-value projects. In the afternoon, she discussed her rotation idea with a few veteran employees and was directly challenged: "If we change it this way, our original rhythm will be disrupted. If something goes wrong, who will be responsible?" Yu Xiaowei suppressed her frustration, noted the objections, reiterated the purpose of the adjustment, and promised that the final plan would balance efficiency. She and Su Lishan exchanged tired but resolute looks and continued combing through the work.

events.name: Clean out the storage room and start the space renovation
events.description: At around 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowei changed into an old T-shirt and sweatpants and cleaned out the storage room full of clutter with Zhang Weiming. The two put on masks and gloves and carried out old cardboard boxes, unused small appliances, expired food, and other items. Recyclables were sorted into large garbage bags, and Zhang Weiming carried them downstairs to the recycling point; the rest of the clutter was thrown into the refuse room. After it was emptied, Yu Xiaowei swept the floor and corners, and Zhang Weiming wiped the yellowed walls and ceiling corners with a damp cloth. Two hours later, the eight-square-meter storage room had regained its original appearance. Covered in dust, the two looked at it with great anticipation.

After the primer was finished, they opened the windows and turned on a fan to speed up airing out the fumes, then quickly left. events.description: At 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowei met Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi at a Hong Kong-style tea restaurant in a mall in Nanshan District. The three ordered a double-roast meat platter, dry-fried beef ho fun, and milk tea. Zhou Minyi raised her cup to congratulate Yu Xiaowei on landing the Shenzhen client, Yu Xiaowei shared her experience from the client meeting, and Huang Wenhui listened quietly. The atmosphere was pleasant, but when Yu Xiaowei went to the restroom midway, she inadvertently caught a glimpse of Huang Wenhui leaning close to Zhou Minyi's ear and whispering, “Are you really going to keep hiding it from her? A Wei will find out sooner or later.” Zhou Minyi shook her head in a fluster. Yu Xiaowei bit her lower lip, splashed cold water on her face in the restroom, and after composing herself, forced a calm look and returned to the table to continue drinking tea. After the gathering, she smiled and said goodbye at the metro entrance, but once she turned away, her smile vanished and doubts surged inside her.

events.name: Commute review, study, and weekend preparation
events.description: At 6 pm, Yu Xiaowei crossed the border from Luohu Port back to Hong Kong. On the return MTR train, she reviewed the outline of this week's online course, tracing key structures on her phone screen with her finger. After getting home in the evening, because the weekend parent-child activities and library plans needed to be arranged in advance, she spent 30 minutes quickly completing 20 multiple-choice questions and put together a list of questions to tackle tomorrow. The total study time that day was about 1 hour.

events.name: Installation of wall-mounted racks and a workbench in the storage room
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei had a simple dinner with her husband Zhang Weiming and the children, sharing how her meeting with her younger brother had gone during the day. At 8:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming took tools into the storage room. Zhang Weiming drilled holes with an electric drill and inserted expansion screws, and together they lifted and fixed the solid wood wall-mounted rack. Next, they assembled the foldable workbench, and Zhang Weiming repeatedly tested how smoothly it folded. After installation, they checked its firmness. Under the light, the white wall set off the natural-wood-colored shelf, and the space began to take shape. Though her hands were busy, Yu Xiaowei could not keep the quiet words from echoing in her mind.

start_state.location: At home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District
start_state.mood: Excited and full of anticipation

2025-09.daily_overview: Saturday was a study sprint day for the second phase of CFP. In the morning she went to the library to tackle difficult points and create a knowledge connection diagram. In the afternoon she went home to finish up practice questions and self-assessment, studying 3.5 hours in total. In the early evening, she experienced professional sports rehabilitation massage for the first time, and after her legs were released, she felt remarkably light. In the evening, she took the initiative to ease the relationship with her father Yu Guoqiang over red wine. As father and daughter chatted over wine, the cold war melted away. The storage room was also finished with lighting, seating, and initial arrangement during the evening.

events.name: Deep study at the library
events.description: On Saturday morning at 9:30, Yu Xiaowei walked to the Kowloon City District Public Library carrying a backpack full of materials. She laid out her books by the window seat and focused on tackling the application of estate tax planning in insurance, drawing a spiderweb-like knowledge map on white paper to connect the dry tax law with real life. At noon, she bought a tuna bun and a bottle of water at a bakery outside the library for lunch. At 1:00 pm, she continued to review the wrong questions in the question bank, using a highlighter to mark the areas that still needed reinforcement. At 3:00 pm, she packed up and went home, photocopying the knowledge map twice before leaving.

events.name: Ran into an old colleague and chatted
events.description: In the library tea break area, Yu Xiaowei ran into her former factory colleague Liu Jiahui (now living in Shenzhen, in Hong Kong on business). The two chatted about old times in surprise for 10 minutes. Liu Jiahui praised her successful career transition, Yu Xiaowei encouraged him to keep developing in the logistics industry, and they exchanged new contact information.

events.name: Phase wrap-up and self-evaluation
events.description: Returning home at 4 p.m. on Saturday, Yu Xiaowei opened her computer in the study and organized the library notes and wrong-answer corrections into her study file. At 7 p.m., she spent 1 hour completing the 10 remaining questions, then opened her self-assessment form and scored each item of the second-phase study one by one. Next to 'Estate Tax Planning' she drew an asterisk and noted 'still needs to be deepened with case studies'. Finally, she sorted all her study materials into folders and neatly placed them on a corner of the bookshelf. Total study time that day was 3.5 hours.

events.name: Booked a sports massage due to stiffness from training
events.description: During the day on September 20, 2025, after two consecutive days of high-intensity interval running training, Yu Xiaowei's right calf gastrocnemius muscle was noticeably stiff, and even walking caused a pulling sensation. She remembered the sports massage therapist recommended by Teacher Wu Xiuying. In the afternoon she called to book a 30-minute deep tissue massage for that evening, at the Commercial Building on Wan Chai Road, 11th floor, and set a reminder on her phone calendar.

events.name: Professional sports rehabilitation massage experience
events.description: At 5:45 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took the MTR to Wan Chai Station and went to the sports rehabilitation center. The massage therapist first assessed her running posture and pointed out that her left leg bore slightly more weight, which could cause her right leg to compensate and become stiff. Then he had her lie flat and used his forearm and elbow to slowly but firmly release the quadriceps and deep fascia bundles on her right leg, gradually increasing the pressure. Yu Xiaowei gritted her teeth through several moments of pain, but then the pain faded and an unprecedented sense of relief swept over her. After the 30-minute session, she sat up from the bed. Her legs felt as if sandbags had been lifted off them, and she couldn’t help jumping a couple of times and exclaiming, “That’s amazing!”

events.name: Awakening of active recovery awareness.
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei changed into pajamas and stretched on the living room floor while reviewing her massage experience. Remembering her coach's saying, 'Only by resting well can you run farther,' she immediately ordered a massage gun on her phone and set a rule: at least one deep relaxation session per week. She added this new habit to her phone's health reminder list, determined to incorporate active recovery into her daily training routine.

events.name: Took out red wine, ready to make peace with her father.
events.description: Yu Xiaowei took out a bottle of Chilean red wine from the bottom shelf of the wine rack purchased at the wine tasting workshop, wiped the thin dust off the bottle with a tissue, and placed it on the dining table. She planned to use the residual warmth of her father's birthday month that evening to have a drink with her father Yu Guoqiang and ease relations (his birthday had passed in August, and they had been cold to each other). Then she found her father's favorite small wine glass, scalded it in hot water, and wiped it dry.

events.name: Dinner and drinks together eased the conflict
events.description: At 7:30 in the evening, the whole family sat together, and her mother Chen Meiling brought out her signature home-style dishes. Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to open the red wine. She first poured a glass for her father, then poured a small half glass for herself, and raised the glass, saying: "Dad, this is the wine I brought back from class last time. Try it." Yu Guoqiang took the glass and took a small sip, and the lines on his face softened a little. During the meal, Yu Xiaowei talked about her work performance and interesting stories. Although her father still had complaints about having his investment rejected last time, the dinner table did not go cold thanks to her mother smoothing things over. After dinner, father and daughter moved to the living room to continue tasting the wine. Her father asked on his own initiative how the marathon training was going, and Yu Xiaowei shared her preparation plan in detail. Her father gave a snort and said, "Why do you need to run that far?" but his tone showed concern. The two chatted for half an hour, slightly tipsy, and a warm current appeared in the father-daughter relationship.

events.name: Storage room lighting, seating, and initial arrangement
events.description: Around 8:30 after dinner, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming continued renovating the storage room. Zhang Weiming stood on an aluminum ladder and installed a high-color-rendering eye-protective lamp on the ceiling. After connecting the wiring, he used the remote control to adjust it to 4000K natural white light. Yu Xiaowei dragged the ergonomic chair to the work table, adjusted the height and lumbar support, then brought a woven rattan storage box from the living room and placed the Cantonese embroidery tools, embroidered works, and yoga mat one by one on the wall-mounted shelf, stepping back to inspect and adjust. Zhang Weiming rubbed his hands and said, "It's starting to look like something."

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
start_state.mood: Clear-headed and goal-oriented.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: Relaxation, warmth, and a sense of fulfillment.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, she took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to Shek O Beach for a community beach cleanup. The mother and daughter picked up three large bags of marine litter together; the hard work under the scorching sun cleansed their souls, and the Moments post drew an enthusiastic response. After returning home, she officially opened the Yue embroidery yoga space for embroidery and yoga tests, marking the completion of the multifunctional space, which became her spiritual corner.

events.name: Beach cleanup preparation
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowei gathered rubber gloves, a trash claw, and large garbage bags at home, helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin put on a pink sun-protection jacket and tied her hair into two pigtails, and changed into light sportswear herself. She picked up her canvas bag, said to Zhang Weiming, who was reading the newspaper, “We’re off,” and led her daughter out the door.

events.name: Drove to Shek O Beach.
events.description: Yu Xiaowei drove her own silver Toyota sedan, taking her daughter, and set off from Kowloon City, driving along the Island Eastern Corridor and Shek O Road. Children's songs were playing in the car, and Xinxin sang along in the back seat. About 40 minutes later they arrived at the Shek O Beach parking lot, and the mother and daughter walked five minutes to the meeting point.

events.name: Beach cleanup and environmental awakening
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei and her daughter gathered with more than twenty community volunteers. She put on gloves and bent down to work, carefully picking up plastic bag fragments, foam pieces, and glass shards left after the typhoon, with sweat dripping onto the beach. Xinxin carried a small basket and conscientiously collected cigarette butts, shouting 'Mommy, I found another one!' every time she picked one up. Together, mother and daughter and the other volunteers filled three large bags of trash. The activity lasted about two hours. When it ended, Yu Xiaowei looked at the clean beach and felt a strong surge of satisfaction. After returning home at 1 p.m., she rinsed off the sand, scrolled through the phone at the sweaty, smiling photos of mother and daughter, edited the text 'For the first time I feel that picking up trash is more meaningful than signing a big contract,' and posted it to Moments. She received a flood of likes and comments from colleagues, running buddies, and clients. Lin Jiaxin instantly replied, 'Take me with you next time!' Yu Xiaowei replied to them one by one, feeling heavy in her heart yet especially fulfilled.

events.name: Cantonese Embroidery Yoga Space officially launched
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowei walked into the multi-functional space carrying the embroidery frame and a yoga mat. She first spread out the unfinished Yue embroidery piece under the new lamp and, sitting in the comfortable chair, plied her needle and thread for about half an hour to test the worktable height and lighting angle, nodding with satisfaction. Then she unrolled the yoga mat and did 20 minutes of Sun Salutation stretches, feeling the tranquility brought by the non-slip mats and soft light. Halfway through, Zhang Weiming opened the door, leaned in to try the folding worktable, and praised it: "It's quite convenient." Together they hung two small decorative paintings on the wall and laid out the remaining non-slip mats on the floor. With that, the multi-functional space integrating Yue embroidery, yoga, and handicrafts was fully completed. Yu Xiaowei took a panoramic photo with her phone and fondly called it her "spiritual back garden."

start_state.location: At home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District
start_state.mood: Full of energy.

end_state.location: Home yoga space with Yue embroidery, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.
end_state.mood: Calm, introspective, and full of love

state.daily_exercise: About 2 hours of bending and carrying during the beach cleanup activity, plus 20 minutes of yoga stretching.

2025-09.daily_overview: On an ordinary workday, after getting off work in the evening, she attended a running group dinner. During the meal, banker running buddy Mr. Chen mentioned high-net-worth clients' interest in handcrafted collectibles, which sparked Yu Xiaowei's idea of combining Cantonese embroidery with insurance business. After calmly deliberating late at night, facing time constraints, she temporarily shelved the cross-industry idea.

events.name: After work, attended a dinner gathering with the running group
events.description: Monday at 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei got off work at the AIA Building and took the MTR to the Hong Kong-style diner in Kowloon City District where she and her running friends often went. The restaurant had already put together a large table, with seven or eight runners seated around it in a lively atmosphere.

events.name: Running group dinner sparks Cantonese embroidery business idea
events.description: During the dinner, everyone chatted while eating about recent races and training anecdotes. Mr. Chen, a runner friend in banking, suddenly mentioned that several high-net-worth clients he dealt with had a strong interest in handicraft collections and were willing to pay high premiums for fine pieces of intangible cultural heritage. Yu Xiaowei's heart stirred. She put down her chopsticks and pressed: “What types do they specifically like? Would they be interested in Cantonese embroidery pieces with a story?” Mr. Chen scratched his head and said he could ask around. Yu Xiaowei quickly jotted down a few keywords in her phone memo.

events.name: Late-night reflection on shelved ideas
events.description: After the gathering, Yu Xiaowei returned home on Prince Edward Road West. After showering, she sat in the study for a while. She flipped through the Cantonese embroidery album gifted by teacher Wu Xiuying, imagining the possibility of combining insurance products with collectible Cantonese embroidery, and even thought of organizing a small appreciation session to attract high-end clients. But after only a few minutes of deliberation, she caught sight of the stacked CFP textbooks and training plan on the desk and laughed at herself, saying, "I barely have time to embroider anymore; how can I expand in this direction?" Knowing that current work pressure, training goals, and family responsibilities had already carved up her time completely, she decided not to pursue the idea for now, but kept the few notes in her memo.

start_state.location: Desk at AIA Building
start_state.mood: Busy and engaged

end_state.location: Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, study at home
end_state.mood: A sudden flash of inspiration, then a return to reality, with a trace of regret.

2025-09.daily_overview: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowei met running partner Shen Peiwen at Victoria Park and completed a 10 km morning run at a steady pace. During breakfast, she uncharacteristically confided in Shen Peiwen about stress and management challenges, receiving patient listening and encouragement, and her mood clearly improved. The family cat caused a little chaos, but it soon settled down.

events.name: Run meetup confirmation.
events.description: The night before, Yu Xiaowei confirmed via WhatsApp with her running partner Shen Peiwen that they would meet at the main entrance of Victoria Park at 6:30 the next morning for a 10 km morning run at a pace of about 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, and afterward go to their favorite Hong Kong-style café for breakfast.

events.name: Early morning meetup and gathering
events.description: At about 6:20 a.m. on September 23, 2025, Yu Xiaowei changed into a bright orange running singlet and dark shorts, put on her Asics running shoes, and set off from her home on Prince Edward Road West, combining jogging and walking to reach the main entrance of Victoria Park. She met Shen Peiwen, who had already been warming up, at 6:30 sharp. The two high-fived and then began dynamic stretching.

events.name: Completed a 10 km morning run together
events.description: At 7 a.m., the two entered the running track at Victoria Park side by side, morning light filtering through the canopy onto the path. They kept a similar pace, footsteps in sync and breathing steady. At the 5th kilometer, Shen Peiwen mentioned that a student in her class had scored zero again, making Yu Xiaowei laugh; at the 8th kilometer, Yu Xiaowei was a little out of breath due to several nights of staying up late, and Shen Peiwen proactively slowed half a step to let her adjust. In the end, the two completed 10 kilometers in 1 hour 3 minutes.

events.name: Deep conversation at breakfast and emotional support
events.description: The morning run ended around 8 o'clock. The two walked into a Hong Kong-style cafe. Yu Xiaowei ordered a pineapple bun and Hong Kong-style milk tea, and Shen Peiwen added wonton noodles. Shen Peiwen noticed that Yu Xiaowei was not as talkative as usual and asked directly: 'Do you have something on your mind?' Yu Xiaowei hesitated for a moment, then poured out her work pressure, frustrations with team management, and the unsettling conversation she had heard in Shenzhen. Shen Peiwen put down her chopsticks and listened attentively, nodding from time to time, and shared her own experience of gradually reducing stress in primary school teaching. Finally, she gently patted the back of Yu Xiaowei's hand and said, 'Some things can't be hurried. They may have their own difficulties in not telling you. Don't push yourself too hard.' The pleasant conversation made Yu Xiaowei's shoulders relax.

events.name: Agreed to meet again next week.
events.description: After breakfast around 9 a.m., before the two said goodbye at the entrance of the Hong Kong-style diner, Shen Peiwen held out her pinky and said, "Next Tuesday, same time, same place. Don't stand me up." Yu Xiaowei smiled and linked her pinky: "I'll definitely be there!" The two left separately. Yu Xiaowei walked home, took a quick shower, and changed into professional attire.

events.name: Cat messing up the tidying
events.description: After taking a shower, Yu Xiaowei found that the orange cat at home had knocked over the embroidery thread box on the living room coffee table, leaving the colorful threads tangled into a mess. She was in a hurry to get to work, so she could only stuff the tangled threads into a storage bin, planning to sort them out when she came back in the evening, feeling both annoyed and amused.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the morning run

end_state.location: Desk at AIA Building
end_state.mood: Relaxed and understood

2025-09.daily_overview: In the evening, she had an efficient WeChat video call with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to confirm details of the National Day family gathering, and took the opportunity to ask about Tencent's insurance benefits to gather information for expanding corporate group insurance. Before bed, she used a massage gun for self-relaxation, continuing her new active recovery habit.

events.name: Preparing for a video call
events.description: After coming home from work at around 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowei charged her phone to full and went to the spot in the living room with the strongest Wi-Fi to test its stability. She opened WeChat and confirmed the green dot was lit next to her younger brother's profile picture. She opened her notebook and wrote down the points to discuss: two options for the family dinner location, the channel for purchasing Ocean Park tickets, and her plan to ask her younger brother to help her learn about Tencent's insurance benefits. She stretched her neck and made a video call.

events.name: Sister and brother video call to arrange National Day plans.
events.description: Yu Xiaowei had a video call on WeChat with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was far away in Shenzhen, lasting about 45 minutes. On the screen, her brother held his son, who was wearing a footed pajama onesie. The two confirmed their National Day holiday plans: on the evening of October 1, they would have dinner at a time-honored Cantonese restaurant in Kowloon City, and her brother would be responsible for booking the table; on October 2, the whole family would take two cars to Ocean Park, and Yu Xiaowei would buy the tickets online; October 3 would be free time. Yu Xiaowei skillfully steered the conversation toward work and took the opportunity to ask about Tencent's insurance benefit plans, including outpatient, hospitalization, and group insurance coverage. Her brother pulled up the company's internal page and screenshotted it for her. She quickly saved the screenshot, thinking this information might serve as a reference for expanding corporate group insurance. The call ended with relaxed laughter.

events.name: Compile the confirmed information and share it with family
events.description: After the video call ended, Yu Xiaowei immediately wrote down the confirmation information in list form: the dinner restaurant was set at Qi Ji Cantonese Restaurant at 6:30 p.m. on October 1, with 9 people in total; Ocean Park tickets had been booked via the mobile app, with a meet-up at 9 a.m. on October 2; attached was a summary of the key points of Tencent Insurance sent by her younger brother. She took a photo of the list and sent it to her brother via WeChat for confirmation, and her brother replied with an OK gesture. She then went to the living room and verbally briefed her mother, who was folding clothes, and her husband, who was watching TV, on the general arrangements to ensure everyone was on the same page.

events.name: Using a fascia gun on herself for the first time
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei took out her newly bought massage gun and, following the instructions, moved it slowly over her thigh and calf muscles for a 15-minute self-relaxation. Feeling a slight warmth deep in her muscles, she decided to do this at least once a week from then on.

start_state.mood: In an orderly manner
