2025-05.daily_overview: During the Labor Day holiday, Yu Xiaowei kept her usual routine. In the morning, she audited a CFP online course at home and began planning her study pace; later in the morning, she went with her husband to Kwun Tong to visit his recovered mother-in-law, and the family was joyful. In the evening, the whole family gathered for a celebration dinner; her mother Chen Meiling did the cooking, and the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law relationship grew closer.

events.name: Attended a CFP basic course trial in the morning
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei opened the first video of the CFP foundational course in the study to explore the possibility of shifting her study from evenings to the early morning. However, she planned to start the new routine next week, and today was just a warm-up.

events.name: Morning flow yoga practice
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei did 10 minutes of flow yoga and 5 minutes of meditation by the bedroom window, focusing on breath and stretching, to gather energy for the day.

events.name: Visiting her mother-in-law Li Shufen, who has recovered
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming drove to her mother-in-law's home in Kwun Tong District. Her mother-in-law Li Shufen had fully recovered from her ankle injury and was in a great mood. She personally cooked a pot of green radish and carrot pork bone soup. The two women chatted and laughed in the kitchen, their relationship having grown closer through the earlier caregiving.

events.name: Family Labor Day dinner gathering
events.description: In the evening, her mother Chen Meiling was the head cook, and her father Yu Guoqiang, her husband, and the two children sat around the table enjoying Cantonese dishes such as steamed grouper and a roast-meat combination, celebrating the mother-in-law's recovery and the holiday. During the meal, her mother recalled stories of the older generations' labor, filling the atmosphere with warmth.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Holiday relaxation, looking forward to family time

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Content and tired, family warmth makes her feel at ease

state.daily_exercise: 10-minute morning flow yoga, 5-minute meditation

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day of the holiday, Yu Xiaowei tried to get up a little earlier. She studied for the CFP in the morning, handled family chores in the afternoon, enjoyed a rare lunch for two with her husband at noon, and looked up materials on low-risk wealth management products in the afternoon to build knowledge for future financial planning.

events.name: Morning CFP study and yoga
events.description: Yu Xiaowei got up at 6:00 in the morning and did 12 minutes of yoga and 5 minutes of meditation, then studied Module 2 of the CFP course from 7:00 to 9:00, focusing on the insurance regulations chapter. Her husband Zhang Weiming made coffee for her.

events.name: Couple's lunch date.
events.description: At noon, Yu Xiaowei and her husband left the children with her mother and went to a long-established cha chaan teng in Sham Shui Po, where they ordered wonton noodles and pineapple buns. The rare time alone together led them to talk about old memories and recent pressures. Zhang Weiming chatted amusingly about the repair industry, while Yu Xiaowei confided her worries about pressure from her father.

events.name: Research low-risk family financial management
events.description: At home in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei searched online for HSBC low-risk money market funds and fixed deposit products. She initially shortlisted two funds that matched her conservative style, noted them in her phone memo, and planned to consult account manager Li Guodong at the end of the month.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Relaxed, looking forward to time for the two of them

end_state.location: Home study room
end_state.mood: Satisfied, having taken the first step in thinking about the family financial plan

state.daily_exercise: 12 minutes of yoga, 5 minutes of meditation

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowei braved a rain shower to take her daughter Zhang Yuxin to ballet class, and used the waiting time to handle work messages and read CFP materials. In the afternoon, she stayed home with her son to help him with a science craft assignment. In the evening, the family of four watched an animated movie at home, simple and fulfilling. But in the morning, her yoga session was cut short because the orange cat vomited.

events.name: Taking my daughter to ballet class.
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei drove her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the ballet studio in Kowloon Tong, reminded her to wait after class, and after watching her daughter enter the classroom, she quickly replied to client messages on her phone in the corridor outside the classroom, then opened the CFP electronic textbook to review insurance law provisions.

events.name: Orange tabby cat suddenly develops hairball syndrome
events.description: At 5:50 a.m., the orange tabby cat at home suddenly vomited up a hairball. After Yu Xiaowei cleaned it up, she shortened her yoga to 8 minutes and meditation to 3 minutes, then quickly got ready and took her daughter to school. The incident reminded her to give the cat hairball gel every day.

events.name: Make a small science invention with my son.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei and her son Zhang Zixuan sat at the dining table and made a simple fan using a cardboard box and a small motor, as preparation for the school science invention competition. Her son demonstrated it excitedly while she patiently guided him and took photos to record the moment.

events.name: Family movie night
events.description: The evening shower continued, and the family huddled on the living room sofa watching the animated film Coco. Yu Xiaowei held her daughter, her husband wrapped his arm around their son, and they enjoyed a leisurely night.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: A bit busy but looking forward to quality time with the kids

end_state.location: Living room sofa
end_state.mood: Relaxing and recharging with family warmth.

state.daily_exercise: 8 minutes of yoga, 3 minutes of meditation, and 2 micro-training sessions.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowei's family went to Lei Yue Mun for dim sum with her maternal grandmother Chen Meiling and her father Yu Guoqiang. Afterwards, they took the children to the park to play. In the afternoon, they went home to rest. In the early evening, she began preparing for the next week's work and completed CFP practice questions. She decided to officially start her early-morning study mode from tomorrow.

events.name: Family dim sum gathering
events.description: At 9 a.m., the family went to Lei Yue Mun Seafood Restaurant for dim sum. Father Yu Guoqiang had a good appetite; mother Chen Meiling fed the granddaughter ma lai go while eating; Yu Xiaowei ordered a tableful of dumplings for the family, including har gow, siu mai, and char siu bao. During the meal, her father brought up news about pension investment, and she deftly changed the subject.

events.name: Quality family time at Kowloon Park
events.description: After morning tea, Yu Xiaowei and her husband took the children to Kowloon Park. Their son climbed on the playground equipment, their daughter played in the sandpit, and the couple sat on a bench chatting and enjoying the sunshine.

events.name: Evening CFP practice and work preparation
events.description: At 9 p.m., after the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei did a set of CFP risk management chapter exercises in the study and organized the client materials for Tuesday's visits, fully preparing for the workday. She set her alarm to 4:55 a.m. and resolved to follow the new routine.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Lazily looking forward to family day

end_state.location: Study
end_state.mood: Slightly anxious about work, but determined to accept the new pace.

state.daily_exercise: 12 minutes of yoga, 5 minutes of meditation, and 8,000 steps of walking.

2025-05.daily_overview: On a compensatory rest day, Yu Xiaowei carried out her plan of waking up at 5 a.m. to study for the first time. In the morning she focused on CFP; in the afternoon she sorted out her promotion application materials. During this time she received a suggestive phone call from her supervisor Liang Zhenhua, which left her both expectant and nervous. In the evening, because her mother had made a surprise late-night snack, she went to bed a little later.

events.name: First pre-dawn CFP study session
events.description: Waking up promptly at 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei studied the CFP tax and estate planning module in her study for two hours. Whenever she got stuck on calculation problems, she marked the key points and planned to ask a classmate next week. During a break, she drank a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea to refresh herself.

events.name: Focus on tackling the difficult CFP topics.
events.description: Still at home in the morning, Yu Xiaowei spent three hours concentrating on doing practice problems and organizing her notes, grouping the difficult points by category.

events.name: Received a call from my supervisor with a hint.
events.description: At 3 p.m., her supervisor Liang Zhenhua called. His tone was calm, but there was something behind his words: "Xiaowei, you've been doing well lately. There may be some adjustments at the company next week, so be prepared." Yu Xiaowei sensed the hint of a promotion, excitedly jotted down the key points, and immediately began organizing her personal performance summary and a draft team plan.

events.name: Mother's late-night snack surprise
events.description: At 10 p.m., her mother Chen Meiling cooked red bean soup, invited her to taste it, and chatted about old times. Yu Xiaowei found it hard to refuse, so her bedtime was delayed to 23:00, but the warm mother-daughter conversation warmed her heart.

start_state.location: Study
start_state.mood: Firmly executing the new plan, staying focused

end_state.location: Study
end_state.mood: Excited and nervous, going all out to prepare for the promotion.

state.daily_exercise: 15-minute morning yoga, 5-minute meditation.

2025-05.daily_overview: The workday began. After studying in the early morning, Yu Xiaowei commuted to work and handled routine matters. In the afternoon, she received a call from her father Yu Guoqiang urging her to make a high-risk investment, and a verbal conflict broke out, leaving her emotionally upset. In the evening, she called her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng for support, feeling both guilty and helpless toward her father. Due to her emotional turmoil, she had difficulty falling asleep at night.

events.name: Early-morning study and commute.
events.description: Studied CFP from 5:00 to 7:00 a.m., did practice questions on the subway during the commute, and after arriving at the office, briefly discussed future collaboration with the colleague who was about to become my subordinate and had already heard the rumors.

events.name: Phone call about father's investment conflict
events.description: At 4 p.m., her father Yu Guoqiang called again, sounding impatient, asking whether she had finished researching the tech stock he had mentioned last time and saying that he was not trying to harm her. Yu Xiaowei explained that high-risk investments were not suitable for retirement funds, but her father became emotional and accused her of helping outsiders rather than helping her own father, then hung up. She wiped away her tears in the bathroom, feeling conflicted.

events.name: Confided in her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yu Xiaowei had a video call with her younger brother in Shenzhen, sharing her worries about her father's pressure. Her brother comforted her: 'Dad is just bored; we'll guide him gradually,' and suggested recommending low-risk bond products. She felt somewhat relieved.

start_state.location: Home study room
start_state.mood: Slightly tired but perked up

end_state.location: On the bed in the bedroom
end_state.mood: Low mood; helpless and guilty toward her father; insomnia until late at night

state.daily_exercise: 12 minutes of yoga, 5 minutes of meditation, and 10 minutes of evening stretching.

2025-05.daily_overview: On a workday, after studying in the early hours, Yu Xiaowei felt fairly energetic. In the morning she visited her long-time client Chen Meiling and completed a policy review. In the afternoon she returned to the office to handle paperwork. In the evening she had a casual gathering with her colleague Su Lishan at a nearby cha chaan teng, exchanging thoughts about work pressure and promotion expectations, and encouraging each other. Before bed, she extended her meditation to calm her mind.

events.name: Early Morning Study and Visiting Client Chen Meiling
events.description: From 5:00 to 7:00 in the early morning, she studied for CFP. At 10:00 in the morning, she arrived at client Chen Meiling's home in Taikoo Shing, completed the annual family policy review, and updated the children's education fund benefits. Mrs. Chen was satisfied with the service and mentioned that a friend might be interested in taking out insurance. She noted down the lead.

events.name: Small get-together with colleague Su Lishan at a cha chaan teng
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan had milk tea and pineapple buns with butter at a Hong Kong-style café near Gloucester Road. The two talked about the recent rumors of company restructuring. Su Lishan encouraged her, 'You can definitely do it,' and shared her experience managing a small team. Yu Xiaowei felt relieved and noted down a few management tips.

start_state.location: Home study room
start_state.mood: Recover a calm, normal mindset and get back to work

end_state.location: Restaurant
end_state.mood: Relieved; colleagues' support boosts confidence.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning yoga, 8 minutes of meditation

2025-05.daily_overview: On a thunderstorm day, Yu Xiaowei worked from home for half a day, handled team-building details in the afternoon, and continued her CFP studies in the evening. Her husband Zhang Weiming showed signs of distraction for the first time, and she only expressed brief concern before going back to her review. At night, thunder affected her sleep; after getting up, she used meditation to help herself fall asleep again.

events.name: Working from home and team preparation
events.description: Because of thunderstorms, the company allowed employees to work from home. In the morning, Yu Xiaowei attended the regional weekly meeting by video at home, then sorted through the resumes of potential team members to prepare for the handover next week. At noon, she had a home-cooked meal with her mother and children.

events.name: Her husband's first silence while she studied in the early morning
events.description: At 5 a.m., while studying CFP investment planning in the study, Yu Xiaowei noticed that her husband Zhang Weiming was not reading as usual but staring blankly at the TV. She asked, "What's wrong?" He only answered, "Nothing." Since her mind was on formulas, she did not pursue it and continued with her review.

events.name: A thunderstorm disturbed her sleep.
events.description: In the middle of the night, thunder crashed loudly. Yu Xiaowei woke with a start and had trouble falling asleep again, so she got up and did a 10-minute meditation to relax in the bedroom, finally falling asleep again around 2 a.m. Fortunately, she adjusted her early-morning study to start at 7.

start_state.location: Study
start_state.mood: Returning to normal work after the holiday pace, feeling slightly restless.

end_state.location: Study
end_state.mood: Slept poorly because of the thunderstorm, but kept going and finished the study.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning yoga, 10 minutes of meditation.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Friday, Yu Xiaowei focused on wrapping up the week's work. In the afternoon she attended a department meeting, where her supervisor Liang Zhenhua publicly praised her recent performance, and colleagues discussed her promotion. After returning home in the evening, she had a brief conversation with her husband and prepared for the weekend activities. In the evening she did an extra 15 minutes of core training to release stress.

events.name: Department weekly meeting and public commendation.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Liang Zhenhua chaired the regional meeting. While summarizing monthly performance, he singled out Yu Xiaowei for praise on her client retention and policy expansion results, hinting at "greater responsibility." Her colleague Su Lishan led the applause, and Yu Xiaowei's cheeks flushed slightly.

events.name: Evening family chat
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her husband and mother in the living room about the progress of her daughter's ballet class. Her husband offered to take their daughter on the weekend so she could rest more. Yu Xiaowei smiled and agreed, and they discussed Mother's Day plans.

events.name: Extra impromptu core training
events.description: After returning home from work, Yu Xiaowei still felt stressed, so she did a 15-minute combo of planks and lunges in the living room. After sweating, she took a shower and felt refreshed.

start_state.location: Home study room
start_state.mood: Looking forward to the weekend

end_state.location: Living room
end_state.mood: Relaxed, family harmony after releasing stress

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning yoga, 10 minutes of meditation, 15 minutes of core training

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, after studying in the early hours, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter to ballet class, then went to Kowloon Tsai Park for a recovery jog to restart marathon training; in the afternoon, she visited her Cantonese embroidery teacher Wu Xiuying with a butterfly dance sketch inspired by her daughter's painting, received professional guidance, and made her first stitches, feeling physically and mentally fulfilled. After the run, Shen Peiwen sent congratulations and they agreed to run together again in September.

events.name: Early-morning CFP study and deepening silence between her and her husband
events.description: At 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei was in her study tackling the CFP investment calculation chapter. Her husband Zhang Weiming stayed with her as usual, but unlike his usual focus, he frequently spaced out and was silent. Yu Xiaowei, absorbed in exam preparation, only said a brief word of concern and continued doing practice problems, faintly sensing something unusual but not digging deeper.

events.name: Take daughter Zhang Yuxin to ballet class.
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei drove her 5-year-old daughter to the ballet school in Kowloon Tong. On the way, she told her daughter to wait for Mommy after class, and the girl nodded obediently. She planned to use the one-hour wait to resume running.

events.name: Drove to Kowloon Tsai Park to prepare for a run
events.description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei drove about 5 minutes to the Kowloon Tsai Park parking lot. After getting out, she changed into running shoes, opened the running app on her phone, and did dynamic warm-ups: two sets each of high knees and butt kicks.

events.name: Recovery jog of 4.6 km on the park's inner loop.
events.description: Starting from the park entrance, she jogged at a steady pace along the inner track, with a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, covering 4.6 kilometers in total. Having been out of training for a while, she felt some discomfort in her heart and lungs, but she gradually accelerated in the final kilometer, and her body regained a sense of lightness, leaving her feeling joyful.

events.name: Post-run static stretching and hydration
events.description: After the run, I did 10 minutes of static stretching on the lawn, focusing on loosening the hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves, while drinking half a bottle of sports drink. I also reviewed the running data on my phone app, and my heart rate recovered steadily.

events.name: Pick up daughter and share the joy of running
events.description: After stretching, Yu Xiaowei drove back to the ballet studio to pick up her daughter. On the way, she shared the funny story about overtaking passers-by during her run, and her daughter giggled. Inwardly, she decided to gradually resume her weekend morning running habit to build a foundation for the autumn Osaka Half Marathon.

events.name: WeChat congratulations from running friend Shen Peiwen
events.description: On the way home after the run, she received a WeChat message from her running partner Shen Peiwen, praising her for timing her return to running well. Yu Xiaowei replied with thanks and said that because she was busy lately, her night runs would tentatively resume in September. Shen Peiwen said she understood.

events.name: Organize butterfly design drafts and prepare embroidery materials
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei sorted out the colorful butterflies her daughter had drawn in the study, and based on them drew embroidery sketches for the Butterfly Dance series, selecting suitable embroidery hoops, blue, purple and gold silk threads and other tools, making full preparations for visiting Teacher Wu Xiuying in the afternoon.

events.name: Go to Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio in Sham Shui Po
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took her sketches and tools, rode the MTR from Kowloon City to Sham Shui Po, and walked to the studio at 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, organizing in her mind the color scheme and stitching issues to discuss on the way.

events.name: In-depth discussion with Teacher Wu on the butterfly dance sketch
events.description: After arriving, Yu Xiaowei showed the butterfly dance sketch to her teacher, Wu Xiuying. The two sat together and discussed the contrasting gradient color schemes of traditional Cantonese embroidery, as well as stitching techniques suitable for butterflies such as layered stitch, seed stitch, and rolling stitch. Wu praised the creativity and suggested adjusting the perspective details of the wings.

events.name: Teacher Wu demonstrated three Cantonese embroidery stitch techniques
events.description: Teacher Wu demonstrated personally on the embroidery hoop: layered stitches for the gradient of the wings, seed stitches to dot the scales, and rolling stitches to outline the contours. Yu Xiaowei watched the techniques intently and asked questions about starting and finishing stitches, which Teacher Wu answered patiently.

events.name: Yu Xiaowei's first attempt at embroidery with her first stitch.
events.description: Encouraged by Teacher Wu, Yu Xiaowei started stitching on the embroidery frame in the studio from the edge of the butterfly. She first used the rolling stitch to outline, then tried the layered stitch. Although the stitches were not perfectly even, she immersed herself in the tranquility and rediscovered the satisfaction of craftsmanship. Teacher Wu occasionally offered little tips.

events.name: Returned home after the creative exchange
events.description: At 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei packed up her tools, said goodbye to Teacher Wu, and took the MTR back to her home in Kowloon City. On the way, she reviewed what she had gained and resolved to practice embroidery every week so that the Butterfly Dance series could be completed as soon as possible.

start_state.location: Study
start_state.mood: Focus on exam preparation and get ready for a fulfilling Saturday

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and content; exercise and hobbies have both resumed.

state.daily_exercise: 4.6 km jog at a pace of 6:30, 18 minutes of morning yoga, 10 minutes of meditation, 10 minutes of post-run stretching.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Mother's Day, Yu Xiaowei got up a little later than usual but still kept up her study. In the morning, she took the children to develop family photos and buy materials. In the afternoon, the whole family made a warm photo wall together; her husband did the fixing, and her mother Chen Meiling was moved to tears. Her son gave a 3D greeting card and her daughter gave a handprint painting, and the family was filled with love. Because of the festive family meal, her weight increased slightly.

events.name: A short rest after studying in the early morning
events.description: Woke up at 5:15 a.m. (because I went to bed a bit late last night), studied for the CFP until 7:15, then did yoga. Relaxed for the rest of the time.

events.name: Take the children to get photos printed and buy materials.
events.description: At 9:30 am, Yu Xiaowei took her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin to the corner print shop in Kowloon City, selected dozens of family photos from her phone, and had them printed. Then they went to a stationery store to buy corkboard, push pins, decorative stickers, and more. The children excitedly picked out colored tape.

events.name: The whole family making a photo wall together
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei spread a cork board on the living room dining table and arranged photos in chronological order with her children—wedding photos, eldest son's birth, daughter's baby photos, and recent family trip souvenirs. The children were responsible for fixing them with tape, while Yu Xiaowei decorated with star stickers, creating a 2-meter-long family memory wall.

events.name: Husband fixed the photo wall, and mother was moved to tears
events.description: After it was finished, her husband Zhang Weiming took out an electric drill and a level and fixed the corkboard to the white wall of the dining room. Her mother Chen Meiling came out of the kitchen and saw the wall full of memories — from holding baby Yu Xiaowei in her arms as a young woman to the growing-up moments of her grandchildren — and was so moved that tears welled up in her eyes, and she kept saying, 'So beautiful, so beautiful.' The whole family gathered around, looking at the photos and telling the stories behind each one. Yu Xiaowei put her arm around her mother and felt even more deeply how important family is.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Warm plan to celebrate the holiday for Mom

end_state.location: Living room
end_state.mood: Moved and happy, family cohesion soars

state.daily_exercise: 18 minutes of morning yoga, 12 minutes of meditation

2025-05.daily_overview: Career milestone: Yu Xiaowei was officially promoted to Deputy Regional Sales Manager. Liang Zhenhua presided over a small meeting to announce the decision. She was under tremendous pressure but full of fighting spirit. Immediately after the meeting, she set about breaking down the team's sales targets and met with new team members for the first time. In the evening, colleague Su Lishan suggested a celebration; they had a small gathering and returned home late. Even so, she still insisted on meditation and simple stretching after getting home.

events.name: Officially promoted to Deputy Regional Sales Manager
events.description: At 9 a.m., in the meeting room of the AIA Building, her direct supervisor Liang Zhenhua held a small team meeting and officially announced that Yu Xiaowei had been promoted to Regional Deputy Sales Manager, taking over a three-person sales team, with team performance indicators newly added to her KPIs. Yu Xiaowei took the appointment letter. Although the pressure suddenly increased, she silently resolved to prove herself through performance.

events.name: Set team sales target breakdown
events.description: After the meeting, in her office, Yu Xiaowei broke down the overall targets to each member based on the company's quarterly goals, wrote them into draft personal performance contracts, and set the weekly meeting time and communication mechanism.

events.name: First brief communication with the new team
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei gathered three subordinates in a small meeting room to introduce the new structure, expressed her expectation of growing together, and assigned initial learning tasks. The team atmosphere was decent.

events.name: Small gathering with colleagues to celebrate
events.description: After work, Su Lishan dragged Yu Xiaowei and two colleagues to a nearby Japanese izakaya to celebrate. They ordered sake and skewers and chatted until 9 p.m. before parting. After returning home, Yu Xiaowei still insisted on doing 15 minutes of stretching and 10 minutes of meditation. She did not go to bed until 23:15.

start_state.location: Home study room (after studying in the early morning)
start_state.mood: Nervous and expectant about today's appointment

end_state.location: Living room at home
end_state.mood: Excited but exhausted, the new responsibility weighs heavy.

state.daily_exercise: 18 minutes of morning yoga, 12 minutes of meditation, 15 minutes of evening stretching

2025-05.daily_overview: On the day after her promotion, Yu Xiaowei dove into hands-on team management: she led her first team morning meeting and assigned specific client follow-up tasks; in the afternoon she communicated with Liang Zhenhua about management authority and support; in the evening she continued her CFP studies while thinking about how to improve team cohesion. That night she went to bed early due to stomach discomfort.

events.name: Hosting the first team morning meeting
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., in the small conference room at the office, Yu Xiaowei held the first formal team morning meeting. She announced the weekly goals, assigned high-quality existing clients such as Chen Meiling to the new hires to practice on, emphasized "service first," and listened to the difficulties of the team members. Su Lishan voluntarily offered to share responsibility for training the new hires.

events.name: Reported the team plan to my supervisor Liang Zhenhua
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowei went to Liang Zhenhua's office to report on the team goal breakdown and initial division of work, and proposed the idea of delegating authority. Liang Zhenhua affirmed it but reminded her, "Delegating doesn't mean not managing; key milestones must be controlled." She took careful notes.

events.name: Evening CFP study and stomach discomfort
events.description: After studying in the early hours, while reviewing at home in the evening, I suddenly felt bloated. I guessed it was due to the greasy char siu rice I'd hurriedly eaten at noon. I drank warm water early and rested, and meditated for 15 minutes before bed.

events.name: Shared insights in the CFP study group
events.description: After the morning team meeting, Yu Xiaowei posted a message in the CFP study group: “After the promotion, I still keep up daily yoga and fragmented training; mental strength is the cornerstone of management.” The message received likes from group members, and she also encouraged a mother who was preparing for the exam.

start_state.location: Home study room
start_state.mood: First day in my new role, confident and ambitious.

end_state.location: Study
end_state.mood: Management stress is gradually showing; stomach discomfort but still able to cope

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of morning yoga, 12 minutes of meditation, and 2 micro workout sessions

2025-05.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowei had one-on-one meetings with her team to understand new hires' expectations; she went out in the morning to visit potential clients, handled policy complaints in the afternoon, and squeezed in CFP study between tasks. When she got home in the evening, she found her husband Zhang Weiming still silent, so she took the initiative to suggest a short weekend getaway, and he reluctantly agreed. Under stress, she ate more at dinner, which led to weight gain.

events.name: One-on-one session to understand the new employee's expectations
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowei had a 30-minute face-to-face meeting with the new recruit He Jiaming, listening to his career plans. He Jiaming was not very enthusiastic about insurance sales, so she patiently guided him and set short-term learning goals.

events.name: Go out to visit potential clients
events.description: At 11:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei took the MTR to Central to visit a referred client and present a savings insurance plan. Although she didn't close the deal on the spot, she left a good impression and they agreed to meet again in the latter half of the month.

events.name: Handling customer complaints
events.description: At 3 p.m., she received a client complaint about a misunderstanding of the policy terms. Yu Xiaowei patiently explained, promised to send a written clarification, and coordinated with the back-office department to handle it quickly, preserving the relationship.

events.name: Discussing weekend plans with her husband
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei voluntarily sat beside her husband and suggested taking the kids to hike on Lamma Island on Saturday. Zhang Weiming nodded in agreement but remained quiet. She decided to have a proper talk with him then.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Full of energy, but concerned about family

end_state.location: Bedroom
end_state.mood: Tired, worried about her husband’s condition, but weekend plans bring hope

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of morning yoga, 14 minutes of meditation

2025-05.daily_overview: After a busy workday, Yu Xiaowei headed straight to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for a physical exam. She found that her weight had increased slightly to 56 kg and her blood pressure was normal but on the high side. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes and promised to make adjustments.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowei first took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to a ballet class in Kowloon Tong. After returning home, she joined her husband in cleaning the air conditioner as a family task, and her son eagerly helped by passing tools. The family of three was joyful and harmonious. Yu Xiaowei rewarded her husband with herbal tea and took photos to record the moment. During this, she noticed the orange cat had knocked over a flowerpot, and she cleaned it up with a smile. In the afternoon, she tidied up the house and did short exercise sessions; in the evening, the whole family went to a Cantonese restaurant to celebrate her promotion to deputy manager, but her father Yu Guoqiang wore a cold expression the entire time, making the warmth tinged with a hint of awkwardness.

events.name: Taking my daughter to ballet class.
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei drove her daughter Zhang Yuxin from home to the ballet studio in Kowloon Tong. After dropping her daughter off, she used the waiting hour outside the classroom to handle work phone messages, reply to client inquiries, and read CFP tax module study materials. In between, she also did a 5-minute fragmented core workout in the corridor (wall sit, plank). At 9:45 she picked up her daughter and went home.

events.name: Husband cleaning the air conditioner, showing family teamwork and warmth.
events.description: At around 10 a.m., her husband Zhang Weiming brought out a ladder, bucket, cleaning agent and other tools from home, ready to clean the outdoor units of the two split air conditioners. Their son Zhang Zixuan ran over curiously and offered to help pass tools. Seeing this from the living room, Yu Xiaowei smiled and reminded them to be careful. Then from about 10:30 to 11:20, Zhang Weiming stood on the ladder, skillfully removed the protective covers, and rinsed the heat exchanger fins and fan with clean water and a dedicated cleaning agent, while his son passed him a screwdriver and cloths from below. Yu Xiaowei also helped by handing up cloths from time to time, and the three of them worked together in harmony. Meanwhile, Yu Xiaowei went back to the kitchen to brew two cups of Hong Kong-style herbal tea and brought them to the balcony, then took out her phone to capture her husband's serious expression as he sweated profusely, joking, "Ming, with that look you could be on a home-improvement master show." Zhang Weiming smiled and replied, "Then don't forget to sign me up." At 11:20 a.m., the cleaning was complete, and the air conditioning's cooling effect was noticeably better. Yu Xiaowei handed him the herbal tea and praised her husband, and their son copied his mother and gave a thumbs-up. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

events.name: Clean up the pet cat's mess
events.description: At 11:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei found that the family's orange cat had knocked over a potted houseplant on the balcony, spilling soil all over the floor. She gently scolded the cat while cleaning up the soil and repotting the plant. The cat rubbed against her feet, so she smiled, fed it cat treats, and played with it for a while.

events.name: Lunch break and household chores
events.description: For lunch, Chen Meiling prepared simple wonton noodles, and the family ate and chatted at the table. In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei tidied the living room, accompanied her daughter in drawing and doing crafts, while her son played with puzzles nearby. At 2 p.m., she did her second fragmented core workout at home (bird-dog, glute bridge).

events.name: Family dinner celebrating the promotion
events.description: At 6 p.m., to celebrate Yu Xiaowei's promotion to Deputy Regional Sales Manager, the whole family (Yu Xiaowei, her husband, two children, mother Chen Meiling, and father Yu Guoqiang) went to a Cantonese restaurant in Kowloon City for dinner. The mother attentively picked up food for everyone to liven up the atmosphere, while her husband and children chatted and laughed. However, her father Yu Guoqiang looked displeased throughout, only muttering a perfunctory "Congratulations" when Yu Xiaowei announced her promotion. After that, he silently kept his head down eating or playing with his phone. Seeing this, Yu Xiaowei felt a mix of emotions, but she kept smiling and hosted the dinner, eating without tasting. The dinner ended around 8 p.m. On the way home, her mother quietly comforted her, telling her not to take it too much to heart.

events.name: Evening companionship and bedtime
events.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei watched TV with the children for a while, then got them washed up and ready for bed. Her husband Zhang Weiming, after taking a shower, also sat down beside her and gently held her hand to show support. Before going to bed, Yu Xiaowei did 10 minutes of mindful breathing to ease the emotional fluctuations brought on by the family dinner.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to the weekend family day.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Gratified yet slightly worried; touched by the family's support, but her father's attitude made her faintly uneasy.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowei got up early to buy healthy ingredients, then spent the whole day focused on the CFP foundation course mock exam. In the morning she completed the three-hour online exam and scored 72 points. In the afternoon she made an intensive study plan for the tax calculation section where she had lost marks. During this time, the sound of fire truck sirens outside the window briefly distracted her. She also sent the insurance policy confirmation letter, researched money market funds, and discussed small investments with her husband. In the evening, the two went out separately to buy gifts for their wedding anniversary, and later at home they worked together to complete the team sales process document. It was a busy but fulfilling day; she fit in two short exercise sessions between tasks.

events.name: Buying healthy ingredients at the street market
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowei walked to Kowloon City Market. Following the plan to adjust the dinner structure, she bought chicken breast, salmon, broccoli, spinach, tomatoes, eggs, oats, and other ingredients, spending about 280 Hong Kong dollars. After returning home at 8:30, she sorted the ingredients into the refrigerator to prepare for the week's healthy dinners.

events.name: CFP online mock exam preparation
events.description: At 8:40 a.m., Yu Xiaowei, in her study at home, prepared her laptop, charger, scratch paper, and pen in advance, tested the network connection, and logged into the CFP Association's online exam system to ensure the equipment was running properly. She also put her phone on silent to avoid distractions. She quickly reviewed her tax formula notes.

events.name: Take the CFP foundation course mock exam.
events.description: From 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, Yu Xiaowei took a mock exam for the basic course at her home study via the CFP Association's online examination system. The exam covered modules including insurance, taxation, and retirement planning, lasted 3 hours in total, and had a full score of 100. She answered carefully, paying special attention to the tax calculation questions. Midway through the exam, a fire truck siren sounded outside the window; she was distracted for a moment but quickly pulled herself back together. In the end, she scored 72. After the exam, she felt she was still somewhat unfamiliar with the taxation module.

events.name: Fragmented core training
events.description: After the mock exam, Yu Xiaowei did 5 minutes of core training (plank, bird-dog) on the study room floor to relax her tense shoulders and neck.

events.name: Analyze mock exam results and formulate a review plan
events.description: After lunch at 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowei returned to her study. Comparing her mock exam score with the answer explanations, she focused on analyzing why she lost points in the tax calculation section. She realized her understanding of the differences between cross-border tax rules and those in the mainland was not solid enough. She then made a targeted review plan in her notebook, planning to focus on strengthening tax calculation knowledge points during the 5 a.m. to 7 a.m. time slots over the next two weeks, and arranged to do one special practice session each week.

events.name: Send the insurance policy confirmation letter to client Chen Meiling.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei sent the client Chen Meiling the formal confirmation letter and electronic thank-you letter for the new policy via the company email system, attaching the policy effective date and contact information for follow-up services. She also called to remind Chen Meiling to wait for the underwriting result, demonstrating professional and thoughtful service.

events.name: Research money market funds and discuss investments with my husband.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowei searched online at home for HSBC money market fund product information, then called account manager Li Guodong to ask about detailed terms, including minimum investment amount, fees, and redemption rules. After hanging up, she discussed with her husband Zhang Weiming, who was in the living room, the feasibility of investing 10,000 Hong Kong dollars from the family emergency reserve. Zhang Weiming agreed, saying they could try financial management in small steps.

events.name: The couple each chose gifts for their wedding anniversary.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowei did her second fragmented core workout in the living room before heading out. Then she took a minibus to the Chow Tai Fook jewelry store in Tsim Sha Tsui and carefully selected an elegant pearl necklace as a commemorative gift for herself (Zhang Weiming would pay for it). Meanwhile, Zhang Weiming went to Eslite Bookstore in Causeway Bay and bought a high-end pour-over coffee set. After wrapping their gifts beautifully, the two returned home, preparing to exchange them on their May 20 anniversary.

events.name: Draft a team sales collaboration process document
events.description: After returning home at 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei used the time before dinner to draft and refine the team's internal sales collaboration process document in her study. The contents included customer information sharing standards, cross-referral mechanisms, and team performance statistics methods, laying the foundation for the upcoming quarter's management work. Her husband helped take care of the children playing in the living room.

events.name: Family dinner and evening rest
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowei made a simple dinner with the ingredients she bought in the morning, and the whole family sat around the table. After dinner, she cleared the table and then watched half an hour of cartoons with the children. Before bed, she meditated for 15 minutes and set the alarm for 5 a.m. the next day.

start_state.mood: Feeling refreshed and clear-headed; although there is pressure from exam preparation, I am fully prepared.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong
end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled, satisfied with CFP study progress, slightly anxious about taxation.

Her husband expressed support and praised the taste.

In the early morning she got up early to study, and her husband's silent company planted a seed of unease. In the morning she brought homemade coffee to share with the team; at the morning meeting, Su Lishan voluntarily took on part of the training tasks. She used her lunch break to finish her Japanese study. In the afternoon, she and her husband made their first money market fund investment together. In the evening, the two dressed up and went to the restaurant with a view at The Peninsula Hotel. Over a candlelit dinner, they exchanged gifts and talked candidly. Her husband revealed his thoughts about a career change, and she gave him firm support. Returning home late at night, she logged the dinner calories in the app and still insisted on meditating before bed.

events.name: Early-morning CFP study with husband's company
events.description: At 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's alarm went off. She got up quietly, drank a glass of warm water, and went to the study to continue studying the CFP tax module. Zhang Weiming also followed her out habitually, sleepy-eyed, and sat on a chair beside her for company. But he was clearly troubled. He stared blankly out the window for a long time and gave only brief responses to Yu Xiaowei's questions. Although Yu Xiaowei felt a vague worry, she only silently patted his shoulder without deeper communication, due to exam pressure and time constraints.

events.name: Morning yoga and homemade coffee
events.description: After studying until 6:30, Yu Xiaowei did 15 minutes of yoga stretching. Then in the kitchen she used coffee beans and a coffee maker to brew 1 liter of American coffee and poured it into a thermos. She simply ate two slices of bread and left home at 7:30.

events.name: Morning team meeting and proactive task sharing with Su Lishan
events.description: At 8:45 a.m. that day, the team morning meeting was held in the meeting room of the AIA Hong Kong office in Wan Chai District. Yu Xiaowei poured homemade coffee into paper cups and handed them out to the team members; the atmosphere was relaxed. During the meeting she assigned the week's tasks. At that point, senior team member Su Lishan proactively raised her hand and offered to take on part of the new-hire training work so that Yu Xiaowei could focus more on maintaining key clients. Yu Xiaowei thanked her on the spot and initially assigned Su Lishan the module for basic product training.

events.name: Refine the training handover with Su Lishan
events.description: After the morning meeting ended around 9:30, Yu Xiaowei proactively invited Su Lishan to the break room to further discuss the specific content, schedule, and handover process for new-hire training. The two agreed that Su Lishan would lead the product training every Wednesday morning. Yu Xiaowei sincerely thanked Su Lishan for proactively taking on part of the work and promised to recognize her contribution in the quarterly performance review. Afterwards, she did a 5-minute micro core workout in the break room.

events.name: Lunch and Japanese study
events.description: At 12:00, Yu Xiaowei ate her homemade salad at her desk and opened the Japanese learning app to complete a 15-minute course, preparing in advance in case she had no time to study in the evening.

events.name: Go to HSBC to open a money market fund account.
events.description: At 1:30 pm, Yu Xiaowei met her husband Zhang Weiming at Wan Chai MTR Station and went together to the HSBC Wan Chai Branch. With the assistance of account manager Li Guodong, Yu Xiaowei filled out the account opening application form, signed the agreement, and transferred 10,000 Hong Kong dollars from the family emergency reserve account into the newly opened money market fund account, completing her first subscription.

events.name: Set up a regular investment plan
events.description: After opening the account, Yu Xiaowei set up an automatic investment plan on the spot via mobile banking, arranging for 2000 Hong Kong dollars to be automatically deducted from her daily savings account on the 20th of each month starting from June 2025 and invested into the money market fund. She confirmed the deduction date, amount, fund code, and other details. Her husband carefully double-checked the details, and the two exchanged knowing smiles, taking a new step in family financial management.

events.name: In the evening, she dressed up carefully for the dinner banquet.
events.description: At 5 p.m., the two returned to their home in Kowloon City. Yu Xiaowei changed into a light blue dress, put on pearl earrings and her newly bought handbag, while Zhang Weiming put on a dark suit and a tie. The dress zipper was a bit tight. When her husband helped adjust it, he noticed a slightly loose thread. Yu Xiaowei quickly took out a needle and thread and sewed a few stitches. The two were in a happy mood and ready to go out to celebrate.

events.name: Drove to The Peninsula Hotel
events.description: At 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband drove their Toyota car from their home in Kowloon City District to The Peninsula Hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui. On the way, they talked about the day's funny moments with the children and marveled at how quickly time flew. The drive took about 20 minutes, and they used valet parking upon arrival.

events.name: 15th wedding anniversary dinner
events.description: From 6:30 to 9:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband celebrated their 15th wedding anniversary with dinner at Felix restaurant on the 28th floor of The Peninsula Hotel. Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, the night view of Victoria Harbour was dazzling, and the table was elegantly set. During the meal, Zhang Weiming took out a pearl necklace and put it on her himself, and Yu Xiaowei gave him a pour-over coffee set in return. The two enjoyed a four-course French dinner while recalling how they first met working in a factory, rented a small room, and now had both a son and a daughter, and they were filled with emotion. Zhang Weiming candidly said he was considering transitioning from an air-conditioning repair technician to new energy vehicle maintenance, and Yu Xiaowei immediately expressed full support, saying he deserved to pursue better development. The couple's relationship was further strengthened through their honesty.

events.name: Returning home and going to bed.
events.description: After the dinner party ended around 9:30, the two drove back to their home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City. When they arrived, the children were already asleep, and her mother was waiting in the living room knitting. Yu Xiaowei and her husband chatted for a while in the living room about the emotional moments of the evening, and briefly discussed his enrolling in a course. She opened the app to record the calories from dinner, then washed up and did 10 minutes of meditation before bed. She fell asleep at around 11:15.

Shen Peiwen encouraged Yu Xiaowei not to give up and suggested resuming systematic training starting in autumn, with the goal of challenging her half marathon personal best in the second half of the year. Yu Xiaowei suggested that the two of them do core training together every Sunday morning via WeChat video to keep each other accountable. Shen Peiwen raised her glass in agreement.

Shen Peiwen strongly urged Yu Xiaowei to try them on. They felt comfortable on her feet, and on impulse Yu Xiaowei swiped her card to buy them, spending 800 yuan. Shen Peiwen joked that she was 'investing in a future PB'; Yu Xiaowei felt a little pain but was happy.

At 2:00 p.m., they said goodbye at the subway station: Yu Xiaowei took the same route back to Hong Kong through Lo Wu Port, waited another hour in line for immigration, and arrived home in Kowloon City District at 4:00 p.m.; Shen Peiwen returned to Kwun Tong District via Futian Port and texted to report that she was safe after arriving home.

events.name: In the evening, go home to help prepare ingredients for the Dragon Boat Festival.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowei left work a little early and went home to help her mother. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already started soaking glutinous rice and red beans. Yu Xiaowei helped take the salted egg yolks out of the vacuum bag, helped cut the pork into appropriate sizes, marinated part of it with five-spice powder and soy sauce, covered it with plastic wrap, and put it in the refrigerator, making initial preparations for making zongzi the day after tomorrow.

events.name: Evening video core training with running friend Shen Peiwen.

The routine included crunches, glute bridges, plank variations, and more; the two counted reps and encouraged each other. Shen Peiwen supervised her form, and they agreed to do it every Wednesday evening. Yu Xiaowei was drenched in sweat but felt very fulfilled.

events.name: Evening CFP study and rest.

Then she did a jigsaw puzzle with her daughter for a while, did 10 minutes of relaxation meditation before bed, and used an app to record her exercise.

events.description: At 5:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei drank some warm water, then jogged 2 kilometers in Kowloon Walled City Park. The air was slightly hot and humid. After the run, she went home, took a shower, did 5 minutes of mindful breathing, and got ready for a busy day. She recorded breakfast using an app.

events.name: Pre-holiday work wrap-up
events.description: Arriving at the office at 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei gave priority to two life insurance policies that had to be issued before the holiday and one renewal notice. She checked the team's leave arrangements and reminded everyone to report on time on the first working day after the holiday, June 3. During a break, she did her first micro-workout.

events.name: Brief communication with Liang Zhenhua and a phone conference with Guo Junwei
events.description: At 11 a.m., Yu Xiaowei ran into Liang Zhenhua in the corridor and quickly reported the progress of the cross-border plan. Director Liang reminded her to be mindful of compliance regarding cross-border transfer of client data. At 2 p.m., she had a scheduled 20-minute video call with Guo Junwei to discuss the mainland tax implications of the savings insurance in the plan. Guo Junwei said he would provide an actuarial demonstration, but it would only be ready after the Dragon Boat Festival. Yu Xiaowei said she understood and thanked him.

events.name: Purchase festival supplies before leaving work
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowei left work an hour early (flexible compensatory time off). On the way, she stopped at the Kowloon City Market to buy fresh lychees, mangoes, and other seasonal fruits, and then went to a grocery store to buy cotton string for wrapping zongzi. When she got home, her mother had already begun washing the zongzi leaves.

events.name: Carefully prepared zongzi fillings with my mother.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei put on an apron and continued refining the filling in the kitchen with her mother Chen Meiling: turning the marinated pork pieces from yesterday to let them absorb the flavor, peeling the salted egg yolks, and draining the glutinous rice before mixing in a little salt and oil. The two chatted and laughed as her mother recalled how Xiaowei used to pester her to learn how to wrap zongzi as a child.

events.name: Helping her husband clean the ceiling fan
events.description: Meanwhile, her husband Zhang Weiming was moving a ladder in the living room to clean the ceiling fan. Yu Xiaowei went over from time to time to help hold the ladder and pass towels, and their son Zhang Zixuan also gathered around to watch. The family worked and chatted together.

events.name: Evening family quality time
events.description: After dinner, her father Yu Guoqiang came back from a walk downstairs and, unusually, sat in the living room eating lychees with them. Her son Zhang Zixuan peeled a lychee and handed it to his grandfather; the old man showed a faint smile and awkwardly patted the child's head. Yu Xiaowei sat nearby, feeling somewhat relieved. Her husband Zhang Weiming also played with the children with building blocks for a while. Before bed, Yu Xiaowei completed her second fragmented workout, recorded it in the app, and checked tomorrow's Dragon Boat Festival dragon boat race arrangements. Since rain was forecast, she decided to bring an umbrella.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the eve of the Dragon Boat Festival, Yu Xiaowei briefly handled work at the company on Friday and left early. In the afternoon she went home and helped her mother make the final preparations for wrapping zongzi. In the evening, the whole family gathered in the living room. Her mother demonstrated, Yu Xiaowei taught her daughter step by step to fold the bamboo leaves, and her son tried tying them up. Everyone kept laughing, but her father stayed alone in his room. The wrapped zongzi were put into the pot to cook, and the aroma filled the house. Yu Xiaowei used the app to take photos of the zongzi and record them. Su Lishan sent festival greetings; she replied and they agreed to get together after the festival.

events.name: Morning yoga and work arrangements
events.description: Waking up at 6:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei drank warm water and then did 20 minutes of gentle yoga. Because the company allowed leaving early on Fridays at her discretion, she planned to work only half a day. At breakfast, she checked the refrigerator, confirmed that there was enough glutinous rice, and used the app to record her breakfast.

events.name: The last half day of work before the holiday
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei arrived at the office, dealt with the last few emails, and confirmed that the team had no urgent matters during the holiday. She saved the preliminary draft of the cross-border proposal and set it as the first task after the holiday, then exchanged Dragon Boat Festival greetings with colleagues and left the office at 10:30. Before leaving, she did her first micro-workout in the office.

events.name: Return home to help mother with the preparations for wrapping zongzi.
events.description: Returned home at 11 a.m.; mother Chen Meiling had already laid out all the ingredients again: soaked glutinous rice, cooked red beans, marinated pork pieces, salted egg yolks, cleaned bamboo leaves, and saltwater grass. Yu Xiaowei helped move the long table to the center of the living room, spread newspapers on it, and arranged the ingredients to set the mood for the whole family making zongzi together in the evening. At noon the family had a simple congee with dried scallops.

events.name: Short afternoon rest and time with family
events.description: In the afternoon, a sudden thunderstorm arrived and the sky darkened. Yu Xiaowei held her daughter by the window and watched the rain, telling the story of the origin of the Dragon Boat Festival. Her husband Zhang Weiming was repairing the toy car that their son had broken. Her father Yu Guoqiang was reading the newspaper in his room and did not participate in the family activities. During this time, the orange cat curiously tore at a zongzi leaf. Yu Xiaowei gently stopped it and played with it for a while.

events.name: Making zongzi with the whole family in the evening
events.description: At 6 p.m., the weather had cleared up. Her mother, Chen Meiling, sat at the head of the table and began to demonstrate how to wrap zongzi. Yu Xiaowei sat to her mother's right, hand-over-hand guiding her daughter Zhang Yuxin in overlapping two bamboo leaves and folding them into a funnel shape, patiently telling her to pinch the bottom tightly. Her son Zhang Zixuan, standing nearby, curiously picked up cotton string and tried to tie up the zongzi her mother had wrapped, clumsy but very focused. Her husband Zhang Weiming also joined in clumsily, wrapping a strangely shaped "innovative zongzi" that made everyone laugh. At the end of the activity, Yu Xiaowei took out her phone and filmed the warm scene: her mother's focused face, her husband and son's funny expressions, and the little zongzi her daughter held in both hands. The more than twenty wrapped zongzi were then boiled by her mother. That night, only her father, Yu Guoqiang, stayed in his room the whole time and did not come out, citing joint discomfort. Yu Xiaowei knocked on the door to invite him, but he only replied, "Don't bother with me," leaving a hint of loneliness amid the liveliness.

events.name: Holiday greetings and socializing
events.description: While wrapping zongzi, her WeChat rang. Su Lishan sent a voice message saying, 'Wishing you a healthy Dragon Boat Festival.' Yu Xiaowei smiled, replied with a voice message, and took a photo of herself wrapping zongzi to send over. The two agreed to meet for tea together after the festival.

events.name: Tasting the first zongzi and casual family conversation
events.description: The zongzi were cooked until 9 p.m., when her mother fished out a few for everyone to have an early taste. The family sat around and tasted the salted egg yolk and pork zongzi, and their son kept saying they were delicious. Yu Xiaowei silently noted to leave the two biggest ones for her father to eat the next morning. Before bed, she and her husband cleaned up the living room together. Her husband sighed softly and said, "Take it slow. Dad will understand."

events.name: Preparing the yoga mat for the new habit in June
events.description: Before going to bed, Yu Xiaowei remembered her July habit plan. She took out her yoga mat from the cabinet, checked it carefully, wiped it clean with a damp cloth, placed it in front of the living room floor-to-ceiling window, and set an alarm for 6:30 the next morning. She planned to adjust her morning yoga to 15 minutes every morning starting June 1 to continue her healthy rhythm. She also used an app to record her diet and exercise for the day and wrote a festival mood diary.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the Dragon Boat Festival, Yu Xiaowei got up at 5 a.m. to complete the final sprint for CFP, then did yoga to refresh herself. After the family had zongzi early in the morning, they went to the seaside to watch the dragon boat race and enjoy the festive atmosphere; her father used joint pain as an excuse to be absent, leaving her with mixed feelings. After returning home to rest in the afternoon, her mother cooked a hearty dinner in the evening, and her father finally sat down at the table. At night she had a short conversation with her husband, recorded the day, and meditated, bringing her fulfilling May to a close. She strictly followed her summer weight management plan, and her weight dropped to 55.5 kilograms.

events.name: Early-morning CFP study
events.description: At 5:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowei got up right on time. After drinking warm water, she completed the last set of comprehensive tax questions for the CFP foundation course in her study, with an accuracy rate of 80%. Her husband, Zhang Weiming, still habitually sat in the chair to keep her company, but as taciturn as before, staring out the pitch-black window for a long time. After finishing her studies, Yu Xiaowei sat beside him and asked softly, "Have you been having a hard time lately?" Her husband just shook his head and said, "It's nothing, just a little tired." She did not press further, knowing that the time for deeper conversation had not yet come.

events.name: Morning yoga
events.description: At 6:30, Yu Xiaowei rolled out her yoga mat in the living room and did 20 minutes of yoga stretching and breathing exercises, completing her unshakable daily habit.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival morning tradition
events.description: At 7 a.m., the whole family got up. Yu Xiaowei helped her mother set out the zongzi that had been cooked the night before and cut them open to share. Her son and daughter happily picked out the zongzi they had wrapped themselves. Yu Xiaowei specially took two salted-egg-and-pork zongzi to the door of her father's room. Her father opened the door, took them, and said a faint thank-you.

events.name: Fragmented core training
events.description: Before leaving, Yu Xiaowei did a 5-minute core workout in the living room (plank, crunches) as her first fragmented training session of the day.

events.name: Go to the waterfront to watch the dragon boat race
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's family (Yu Xiaowei, her mother Chen Meiling, her husband Zhang Weiming, Zhang Zixuan, and Zhang Yuxin) set off, taking a minibus to the dragon boat race area at the Kwun Tong Promenade. The weather was hot but crowded; they found a spot a bit further away, spread out a mat, and sat down. The race was full of beating gongs and drums. Her son excitedly pointed at the dragon boats and shouted cheers. Yu Xiaowei took many photos and chatted with her mother about memories of her father taking her to watch dragon boats as a child. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, stayed home alone, citing joint pain and sensitivity to heat. Yu Xiaowei felt a little disappointed inside, but still tried to enjoy the time with her family. They walked about 2 km along the waterfront.

events.name: After the dragon boat race, wandering around and heading home.
events.description: The competition ended at 12 noon. The family had tofu pudding and mango pancakes at a nearby dessert shop to cool off. Then they took a minibus back to Kowloon City, arriving home at 1:30 p.m. The children were so tired that they quickly fell asleep, and Yu Xiaowei also took a forty-minute nap.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival family dinner
events.description: At 6 p.m., her mother prepared a festive dinner: steamed grouper, roast pork, white cut chicken, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and of course zongzi. Her father finally came out of his room, sat at the dining table, and ate quietly, occasionally answering a few words. Yu Xiaowei put a piece of fish on her father's plate, and he nodded. Although there was not much conversation, at least the whole family was seated together. Her husband Zhang Weiming also tried to chat with his father-in-law about the mechanical structure of dragon boats, and the atmosphere eased a little.

events.name: Brief evening couple conversation and childcare
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowei bathed her son and daughter and read them a Dragon Boat Festival picture book. After the children fell asleep, she sat in the living room with her husband. She mentioned that her father had finally joined them for a meal today, and her husband felt relieved too. But when the conversation turned to the future, her husband again showed his worry about the uncertainty of his career transition and grew quieter. Yu Xiaowei held his hand and said she would stay with him as he adjusted, no matter how long it took.

events.name: Second fragmented training and record
events.description: At 9 PM, Yu Xiaowei finished her second short core training session, opened the app to record the day's diet, exercise, and weight (55.5 kg), and nodded with satisfaction at the comparison with her summer weight management plan.

events.name: Check yoga mat and June plan
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei checked the yoga mat in front of the floor-to-ceiling window again, set the alarm to 6:30, and wrote down her June health plan in her phone notes: daily morning yoga, keeping dinners light, and gradually increasing her running distance. She gently kissed her husband on the forehead.

events.name: Meditation and bedtime
events.description: At 10:00 PM, Yu Xiaowei did a 15-minute mindfulness meditation in her bedroom, grateful for May's gains and challenges, then turned off the lights and went to sleep, welcoming the arrival of June.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Yu Xiaowei received a heated complaint at the office from high-net-worth client Mr. Zhang. She had to suspend delegating work and handle it personally, which drained a great deal of energy. Late at night, she accidentally triggered the phone's loudspeaker, provoking a strong complaint from downstairs neighbor Chen Zhiqiang, leaving her embarrassed and apologetic. She was under dual pressure from work and neighbor relations.

events.name: Morning yoga and neck/shoulder discomfort
events.description: I got up at 6:00 and did 15 minutes of yoga, but because my sleep quality last night was average, my neck and shoulders still felt stiff, so I added shoulder circles. For fragmented core training, I only did 2 sets of planks.

events.name: High-net-worth client complaint and follow-up
events.description: At around 10 a.m., she received an agitated call from client Mr. Zhang, who complained that the explanation of critical illness claims under the policy differed from his understanding and questioned the professionalism of the new colleague. Yu Xiaowei immediately calmed him down and noted his concerns, then interrupted the team meeting to focus on analyzing the policy. In the afternoon, after organizing the key points, she called Mr. Zhang and explained for about 45 minutes. His mood eased but he remained reserved, so Yu Xiaowei proactively offered to visit him the next day.

events.name: Maintaining eye-care habits and midday meals
events.description: Under pressure from complaints, I only ate salad and salmon at lunch and logged it with an app. During that time, I felt my eyes were dry, so I used artificial tears and did 5 minutes of eye yoga, continuing to follow scheduled screen breaks.

events.name: Late-night noise sparked a conflict, and she unexpectedly discovered the neighbor was an old client.
events.description: Near 11 p.m., while organizing materials in the living room, Yu Xiaowei accidentally touched the music button on her phone, and the sudden loud sound startled the neighbors. Chen Zhiqiang, a middle-aged neighbor living alone downstairs, knocked fiercely on the door to complain in an agitated tone. Yu Xiaowei immediately apologized sincerely and explained that it was an accidental touch. After opening the door, she could only see the person's face clearly in the hallway light, and was taken aback—the angry neighbor before her was none other than Chen Zhiqiang, a prospective client she had followed up with in April this year but lost due to poor communication. She was momentarily speechless, caught between embarrassment and apology, and could only apologize even more sincerely. Chen Zhiqiang did not seem to recognize her; after complaining, he turned and went downstairs.

events.name: Meditation and relaxation after conflict
events.description: After the conflict, she felt irritated. She managed to do 10 minutes of meditation to calm her breathing before going to bed, went to bed half an hour later than usual, and did not read before sleep.

The client was satisfied, and she then shared her experience in the team group.

events.name: Apologized to a neighbor and former client but was met with a cold shoulder, and a double sense of frustration washed over her.
events.description: During the day, Yu Xiaowei prepared a box of specialty pour-over coffee and a handwritten card. In the evening, she took the gift to the doorstep of Chen Zhiqiang's apartment downstairs. She apologized in person again and handed over the coffee. The neighbor took it with a blank expression, gave only a slight nod, and directly closed the door. The closing door left Yu Xiaowei standing in a daze for a few seconds. She felt frustrated not only by the setback in their neighborly relationship, but also because she couldn't help recalling the past incident in April when poor communication with this Chen Zhiqiang had ended in the loss of a client. The double failure of both relationships made her sigh in the hallway, and she thought to herself: repairing this relationship would probably take a longer time, but one person has to make the first move.

Yu Xiaowei felt grateful—Minyi had worked in real estate agency for many years and indeed had a wide network, and since the three had been friends since middle school, she had never been wary of her close friend. Yu Xiaowei didn't think much of it and immediately sent the client's WeChat contact card and basic needs from her phone. Zhou Minyi then added the client on WeChat, but only exchanged polite greetings without going any deeper.

Looking back on the day, she regretted sending a message to the client and felt vaguely uneasy. Before going to bed, she weighed herself and found her weight had risen to 54.5 kg.

Yu Xiaowei takes the opportunity to recommend a new high-end medical insurance plan, emphasizing global coverage and private ward features. Chen Meiling says she will discuss it with her husband. Unexpectedly, Chen Meiling takes the initiative to say, “I have a close friend who has been asking about insurance lately. I’ll invite her for tea early next month—you should come too.” Yu Xiaowei happily notes down the client’s needs and thanks her.

They briefly confirmed the time and place, and the call lasted about five minutes. After hanging up, she felt a little relieved. events.name: Morning long slow distance (LSD) training.
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei and her running partner Shen Peiwen met on time at the entrance of Kowloon Tsai Park. After a full 15-minute warm-up, they started an 18km LSD training run at a target pace of 6:30 per kilometer. They ran through the blocks along Junction Road, Tung Po Avenue, and other streets, hydrating in front of convenience stores and sharing energy gels every 5 kilometers. Throughout the run, Yu Xiaowei wore a sports watch to monitor her metrics and exchanged tips on breathing and knee protection while running. They accelerated slightly in the last 2 kilometers and finished with an average pace of 6:28 per kilometer. Back on the park lawn, the two stretched together, massaged each other's calves, and took photos. Yu Xiaowei recorded the distance, time, and heart rate zones in detail.

events.name: Morning tea with my father at a teahouse to ease the relationship
events.description: After her morning run, she went home and showered. At 9:45 she walked to the Prince Edward Lotus Fragrance Teahouse. She arrived early and waited. At exactly 10:00, her father Yu Guoqiang appeared, and father and daughter sat down in a booth. At first it was a little quiet; Yu Xiaowei proactively poured tea, brought up the funny story of her brother taking the kid to Ocean Park last week, and also told her father that his grandson had been praised at football class. Her father gradually opened up and asked whether her work was too tiring. He did not directly touch on their investment disagreement, but the care in his words already made his daughter feel the ice breaking. They ordered shrimp dumplings, siu mai, chicken feet, and char siu bao, chatting while eating for an hour and a half. At 11:30, at the door, her father said, “Take care of yourself,” and Yu Xiaowei smiled and nodded. On the way home, she sent her mother a WeChat message briefly explaining how it went, and her mother replied with three thumbs-up.

events.name: In the afternoon, went shopping with best friend Lin Jiaxin in Causeway Bay.
events.description: At 2 pm, she took the MTR to Causeway Bay and met her close friend Lin Jiaxin at Hysan Place. They browsed Japanese-style clothing stores. While trying on clothes, Lin Jiaxin mentioned that she had interviewed for an administrative assistant position on July 14 and still had not heard back, and was feeling a bit discouraged. Outside a boutique, Yu Xiaowei again suggested she get an insurance license, but Lin Jiaxin shook her head and said softly, "I don't want to rely on you for everything. I want to see if I can make it on my own." Yu Xiaowei understood her desire for independence and tactfully changed the subject to Korean dramas. Later they had mango sago pomelo at a dessert shop and chatted casually. At 5:30 they said goodbye at the MTR station, and Yu Xiaowei returned to Prince Edward.

events.name: Evening home recovery and parent-child reading
events.description: After returning home, her legs felt slightly sore, so she did 15 minutes of self-massage and light stretching. At dinner, she drank two bowls of pork bone soup with green radish and carrot made by her mother. After dinner, her daughter brought the picture book The Adventures of Little Fish, Yu Xiaowei sat on the sofa and read the story, while her son played with LEGO nearby. At 9:30 pm, after the children went to sleep, she looked through the morning run photos and posted on Moments: "18km done! Thanks to my best running buddy," and quickly got many likes. Before bed, she did mindfulness meditation and eye yoga, and turned off the lights at 10:30 pm.
