2025-07.daily_overview: Completed a 20-kilometer long-distance training run with running partners in the morning, enjoying a steady pace and mutual encouragement. Test-drove a Toyota Prius with her husband in the late morning; the quiet, smooth driving experience satisfied both of them, and they decided together to place the order. Celebrated in the afternoon and rested at home in the evening.

events.name: Morning long-distance slow run with running partners
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, met up with running partner Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park for a 20 km long slow run. After a 15-minute joint warm-up, they ran along the park track and surrounding routes at a target pace of 6:20 per kilometer, replenishing water and energy gels at aid stations every 5 km. The pace stayed steady throughout; Yu Xiaowei felt her fitness had clearly improved, and chatted with Shen Peiwen about their kids' funny moments, finishing easily. After the run, they did 15 minutes of deep stretching together and agreed to continue joint training next week. She recorded the data with an app and shared it to the running group.

events.name: Morning test drive of a Toyota Prius with her husband.
events.description: After going home to shower and change clothes, at 10:30 she went again with her husband Zhang Weiming to the Toyota showroom in Wan Chai. Sales consultant Mr. Wu had the test drive car ready. The two took turns driving, along Gloucester Road and detouring to Central before turning back. Yu Xiaowei drove first, feeling the car's quietness and the smoothness of the hybrid switch; Zhang Weiming focused on acceleration and the instrument display. During the test drive they talked about how "it will be more comfortable picking up the kids in the future" and agreed that the car suited the family's needs and was environmentally friendly. After returning to the showroom and asking about installment details, they decided to formally place an order.

events.name: Afternoon subscription signing and celebration.
events.description: She immediately confirmed her intention to buy the car with the sales consultant, paid a small good-faith deposit, and agreed to sign the contract and complete the paperwork tomorrow. After walking out of the showroom, they had a simple celebration at a restaurant in a nearby mall, ordering a double platter of roasted meats and iced lemon tea. Her husband, in a rare moment, said, “I’m really happy about changing the car this time.” Yu Xiaowei looked at him, feeling warm inside. After getting home, she excitedly told her mother about the whole experience.

events.name: Evening rest and fun moments with the cat
events.description: Relaxing at home in the evening, her daughter Zhang Yuxin tied a ribbon around the family's orange tabby cat "Bobo", making the whole family laugh. Yu Xiaowei helped her son assemble a new LEGO set, and her husband sorted out the old car documents. Before bed, she did some simple stretching and meditation, turned off the lights at 22:30, and stored up energy for tomorrow's contract signing.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Calm but determined, preparing for long-distance training

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Extremely satisfied; both the car replacement decision and the long-distance running training were completed.

2025-07.daily_overview: After an easy recovery run in the early morning, the family had a busy and joyful day: in the morning they officially signed the contract for a new car and celebrated with a family drive; in the afternoon they cooled off in the family pool as usual; in the evening the couple reviewed their finances together, adjusted the budget, and set up a flexible fund, laying a stable foundation for the second half of the year.

events.name: Early morning recovery jog
events.description: After yesterday's long distance run, she got up at 6 a.m. and went to Kowloon Tsai Park for a 5 km recovery run. She deliberately slowed the pace to around 6:30 per kilometer, keeping it easy and paying attention to her body's feedback; muscle soreness was moderate. After the run, she did 10 minutes of stretching, recorded the data, and went home. She used an app to log breakfast and water intake.

events.name: In the morning, officially signed the contract to purchase a new car.
events.description: At 10 a.m., she went with her husband to the car dealership in Wan Chai again and formally signed the contract to buy a Toyota Prius. They traded in their old car to offset part of the price, paid an initial payment of about 50,000 Hong Kong dollars, and paid the rest in installments. After the paperwork was done, the dealership had the new car ready with a red ribbon tied on it. The couple excitedly got in the car. Zhang Weiming drove, Yu Xiaowei sat in the passenger seat. They first stopped at a nearby gas station to fill up, then drove back to Prince Edward Road West. On the way, Yu Xiaowei took photos and sent them to the family group chat to share the good news.

events.name: Family drive to Victoria Peak to celebrate
events.description: Returning home, she cheerfully led her mother and two children out to the new car. Zhang Weiming drove, winding up from Kowloon Tong and Mid-Levels to Victoria Peak. The children in the back seat pressed against the windows, excitedly looking at the scenery, while her mother praised the car as "quiet and stable." After a brief stop in the Peak car park, overlooking Victoria Harbour, Yu Xiaowei took the first family photo with the new car, happiness welling up in her heart. Then they drove down the mountain and went home.

events.name: Afternoon family pool day (regular tradition).
events.description: After a short lunch break, at 3 p.m., following the new ritual set last week, she took the children to the community swimming pool again. Her husband stayed home to organize the paperwork for the new car and rest. Yu Xiaowei sat under a poolside umbrella with a book about Hong Kong crafts, reading quietly, occasionally looking up to watch the children playing in the water. After swimming for two hours, the family went home relaxed.

events.name: Evening family financial review and budget adjustment
events.description: At 7 pm, the children watched TV with their grandmother. Yu Xiaowei called her husband over and spread out the first-half-of-the-year household account book and receipts on the living room coffee table. They checked income and expenses month by month and found that Yu Xiaowei had overspent by about 3,000 Hong Kong dollars on yoga classes and Cantonese embroidery materials, while her husband had also slightly exceeded the budget because of car repair textbooks and certification exam fees. The two communicated honestly and reset budget amounts for new expenses in the second half of the year, including their son’s intensive football class, their daughter’s additional ballet lessons, and the half-marathon registration fee. Yu Xiaowei proposed setting up a monthly flexible fund of 1,500 Hong Kong dollars, and both agreed. Finally, they organized the adjustment conclusion into a one-page summary and tucked it into the account book. Her husband nodded in satisfaction. Before bed, Yu Xiaowei did mindfulness meditation and used an app to log today’s diet and weight of 54.3 kg (slightly up from yesterday because of the celebratory meal).

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Relaxed, looking forward to a happy family event

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: A feeling of accomplishment and reassurance, with family finances now clearer.

2025-07.daily_overview: Not in the mood for a morning run, I focused entirely on the monthly performance review. In the morning, I carefully prepared the data. In the afternoon, I led the review meeting and directly faced the unmet targets. After the meeting, I spoke with team members to mitigate the risk of attrition and began setting up a customer follow-up system. In the evening, the family went out, and I sorted out my thoughts in solitude and went to bed early.

events.name: Prepare materials for the monthly review meeting in the morning.
events.description: At her workstation in the AIA Building in Wan Chai, Yu Xiaowei exported July's personal and team performance data from the system and created PPT and Excel charts. Personal premiums of 420,000 yuan failed to meet the target, and the team's 1.3 million yuan also fell short. She highlighted the gaps to the targets and compiled recent developments among high-net-worth clients: two cases suspected of being poached, and three clients hesitant to renew. She printed the meeting agenda and drafted speaking points, fully aware of the importance of this meeting. In the morning she only drank a glass of warm water and did not have a formal breakfast; she logged it in the app and planned to eat after the meeting.

events.name: Hosted the team's monthly review meeting in the afternoon.
events.description: At 2 p.m. in the meeting room, presented performance to the team of more than 10 members and directly pointed out the problems: some high-net-worth clients had been lost and new policy conversion was insufficient. Reminded everyone to watch out for competitors poaching, stressing that “our service is the last line of defense.” Encouraged them to share difficulties. Team member Chen Li mentioned that a client had been lured by another company with commission rebates, and Yu Xiaowei immediately took notes. The meeting lasted 90 minutes, and finally it was clearly proposed that a regular client follow-up system would be piloted next week.

events.name: After the meeting, privately talked with team member Chen Li
events.description: After the review meeting, she invited Chen Li to the small meeting room and asked in detail about the details of the client being poached: the competing company, the sales pitch, and the names of the clients involved. After calming Chen Li down, the two analyzed countermeasures together. Yu Xiaowei promised to help Chen Li communicate deeply with core clients and acknowledged Chen Li's timely reporting. The conversation lasted about 30 minutes, and all the information was recorded in a confidential file.

events.name: Organize meeting minutes and draft a follow-up system
events.description: After the meeting, she returned to her desk, organized the meeting minutes, and made a client churn warning list. Determined to strengthen institutional safeguards, she drafted a plan for the Monthly Follow-up System for High-Net-Worth Clients, requiring each person to make at least one follow-up visit per month and to keep a ledger. She set a deadline of next Friday for execution and scheduled a time on the calendar to give a special report to Director Liang Zhenhua next Monday. When she finished, it was already dark, so she turned off the computer and went home. At dinner, she found that her husband had taken the children to eat at her mother-in-law's house. After a simple meal alone, she did eye yoga early and went to bed at 22:00, getting a full 8 hours of sleep.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Slightly stressed, but with clear goals.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Relaxed after the tension, with a clear plan for the next step of management.

2025-07.daily_overview: She started the morning with an easy run and yoga to kick off an energetic day, handled client inquiries and claim follow-ups in the morning, and visited an existing client in the afternoon to strengthen the relationship, unexpectedly gaining an opportunity for a small group insurance plan. In the evening, she took the family to the mall to buy small decorations for the new car. Her daughter accidentally fell and broke the calm, but the evening ended on a warm note.

events.name: Easy morning run followed by early yoga class.
events.description: Got up at 5 a.m., arrived at Kowloon Tsai Park at 5:15 for a 5 km morning run, maintaining a pace of around 6:20 per kilometer, adjusting breathing and cadence in preparation for tomorrow's test run. After stretching, I changed into yoga clothes directly on a park bench, hurried to the community yoga studio in time for the 6:30 Ashtanga morning class. Today's class was relaxed, and I felt a deep connection between body and mind. After class, I went home for breakfast and logged the training expenditure in the app.

events.name: Handle client inquiries and claims progress in the morning
events.description: Arrived at the office at 9:00 and replied to WeChat inquiries from three clients, one of whom was a Shenzhen friend introduced by new client Wang Qiming asking about Hong Kong high-end medical insurance. I patiently answered by voice message and sent a PDF introduction. Then I followed up on last week's claim assessment progress for Miss Liu, confirmed that the payout would arrive within a few days, and called the client to notify her. During the lunch break, I shared yoga tips with Su Lishan and did eye yoga.

events.name: In the afternoon, visited an old client and was introduced
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to Sai Wan to visit Mrs. Huang, a long-term client she had worked with for five years, to plan education savings for her newborn grandson. The conversation went pleasantly; Mrs. Huang proactively mentioned that her sister was also looking for insurance, and they arranged to meet at the office on Wednesday. As she left, Yu Xiaowei felt the value of her long-time client network. On the way back, she stopped by a herbal tea shop in Sheung Wan and had a bowl of 24-herb tea to relieve the heat.

events.name: Evening family shopping for new car accessories and a minor mishap
events.description: After dinner, she took the two children with her husband to a shopping mall in Kowloon City to pick out small hanging ornaments for the new car. Her son chose a soccer ball design, and her daughter picked a princess crown. Yu Xiaowei added a safety charm to the driver's seat, and her husband liked a minimalist phone mount. The family browsed happily for half an hour, but at the entrance to the toy store, her daughter Zhang Yuxin tripped while running excitedly and scraped her knee slightly. Yu Xiaowei quickly picked up her daughter to comfort her, and her husband bought disinfecting wipes and band-aids from a nearby pharmacy to treat the wound. After crying for a while, the daughter broke into a smile. Her mother Chen Meiling called after hearing about it, and Yu Xiaowei told her they were all safe. This little accident made the family more careful, but also added to the intimacy of caring for the children together. After returning home, she read stories to her daughter until she fell asleep peacefully. Before bed, Yu Xiaowei still completed mindful meditation and noted her weight as 54.0 kg.

start_state.mood: Self-discipline, keep training

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Although there were a few minor mishaps, the overall situation was stable and life was orderly.

2025-07.daily_overview: Cancelled the morning run to let the body fully recover and build energy for tomorrow's test run. Handled team paperwork in the morning; in the afternoon met Mrs. Huang's younger sister, a potential client, and signed a new insurance policy. Went to bed early in the evening to store up energy for the end-of-month push.

events.name: Morning active rest and stretching
events.description: To be in top form for tomorrow's 5K test run, I chose not to run today and slept an extra hour. After getting up, I did 20 minutes of gentle yoga stretching at home, concentrating on loosening the hip flexors and hamstrings with deep breathing. At breakfast, I drank the lean pork congee my mother made and logged it in the app.

events.name: In the morning, checked the details of the follow-up policy at the office.
events.description: Arrived at the office at 9, finalized the draft of the Monthly Follow-up System for High-Net-Worth Clients, broke it down into actionable steps, created a standard follow-up record form, and prepared it for distribution at next week's team meeting. Then checked the team members' follow-up sheets and added suggestions to one of He Junwen's records. In between, wore blue-light blocking glasses and did eye yoga.

events.name: Signed a new insurance policy in the afternoon
events.description: At 2:30 p.m., she received Ms. Huang, Mrs. Huang's younger sister, in the office meeting room. For her young family, she recommended a combination of critical illness and accident insurance, with special emphasis on early-stage critical illness coverage. Ms. Huang was very impressed and signed the application form on the spot. Yu Xiaowei skillfully guided her through filling in the information and successfully closed the case. This was a new policy in the last week of the month, and though small, it gave her a sense of achievement. After seeing the client off, she entered the case into the system and sent a message thanking Mrs. Huang for the referral. Before leaving the office, she tidied her workstation, drawing July to a close.

events.name: Return home early in the evening to rest
events.description: Given the test run tomorrow, she left work on time at 5:30. On the way home, she bought the egg tarts the children liked. During dinner, she told her family that she had a test tomorrow and would go to bed early tonight. Her mother had stewed American ginseng chicken soup, and she drank a big bowl. After the children went to bed at 9 p.m., she briefly flipped through her CFP notes for 15 minutes and turned off the lights at 10. Before going to sleep, she checked the battery of her sports watch to make sure it would work tomorrow.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the morning, she pushed hard to complete a 5K test run, with a pace 20 seconds faster than at the beginning of the month, showing significant training results. She briefly wrapped up her work in the morning. In the afternoon came a major moment in her husband's career transition—he officially started as a hybrid vehicle repair apprentice. In the evening, the family watched a craft documentary and celebrated the new beginning with a dinner.

events.name: Early morning 5 km test run
events.description: At 5:30 a.m., I did a 5 km test run alone at Kowloon Tsai Park. Running at full effort, I finished with an average pace of 6:10 per kilometer, 20 seconds faster than my first test this month! After crossing the finish line, I bent over gasping for air, but with a big smile on my face. I immediately recorded the detailed data on my phone, including split paces, an average heart rate of 161, and the subjective feeling of "refreshed." After the run, I did core-strengthening exercises on the lawn: 3 sets of planks (easily holding 2 minutes 30 seconds today), and 3 sets of lying leg raises (15 reps each). After 15 minutes of stretching, I sent a voice message on WeChat to my running buddy Shen Peiwen: "Peiwen, I got a PB! 6:10!" Shen Peiwen quickly replied with a string of clapping emojis. Back home, I excitedly showed the record to my husband. At breakfast, I logged my food in the app and weighed myself; the scale showed 54.0 kg, reaching the goal I'd set at the start of the month. I was overjoyed.

events.name: Morning: wrapping up the last day of work
events.description: After breakfast, she took the new car to the Wan Chai office (her husband had volunteered to drive her last night). In the morning, she sorted out the final July performance report, confirmed that several deals had come in at the end of the month, and the team's total premiums finally stood at 1.35 million yuan—not reaching the target but still an improvement. She sent a brief report to Director Liang Zhenhua, with the draft return-visit policy attached. Then she had a short meeting with the team, emphasizing that the new policy would be launched next Monday, and announced that starting in August, a company running interest group social run would be organized every Friday after work, encouraging colleagues to join. During her lunch break, she ate wonton noodles alone at a cha chaan teng and thought about the August plan.

events.name: In the afternoon, welcomed a new start in her husband's career transition—from electromechanical worker to hybrid vehicle apprentice
events.description: After returning home early in the afternoon—because today was the day her husband Zhang Weiming left his job at the electromechanical engineering company and officially reported to the Toyota Service Center as a hybrid vehicle repair apprentice—at 6:00 pm, her husband came home wearing a brand-new dark blue apprentice uniform, looking a little shy. Yu Xiaowei took a photo of him, and the whole family applauded. Her husband showed off his apprentice tool kit; his mother grinned from ear to ear, and their son looked at the tools with admiration. As Yu Xiaowei watched her husband's slightly shy but hardly concealed excitement, she remembered how in April he had worked overtime at the electromechanical company, come home late, and fallen asleep as soon as his head hit the pillow; the light in his eyes when he said at the dinner table in June, "I want to try learning a trade"; and the earnest way he had taken the initiative to study the specifications in July when the family decided to switch to a hybrid car—all of it seemed to point to this new starting point today. She walked up and gave her husband a hug, and said softly, "Take it slow, our whole family supports you." For dinner, Yu Xiaowei deliberately added an extra dish and cooked her husband's favorite pork ribs with black bean sauce, with less oil and less salt to fit the healthy eating plan. At the dinner table, her husband shared what he had learned on his first day, and Yu Xiaowei listened attentively and encouraged him.

events.name: Evening: Thursday TV Night craft documentary and family discussion
events.description: At 8 p.m., the whole family gathered in front of the TV. This week's documentary was about the craftsmanship of traditional Cantonese opera costumes. My husband said with empathy as he watched, 'Learning a craft isn't easy; you need to be humble and learn from the master.' Yu Xiaowei held his hand in support. Her mother recalled the days when she used to watch Cantonese opera in her youth. The children didn't understand it but sat obediently. After it ended, the family talked about her husband's new beginning and future possibilities. Yu Xiaowei felt the family bond grow stronger and wrote in her notebook, '7.31 Weiming's new start, supported by the whole family.' Before bed, she completed mindfulness meditation and eye yoga, and turned off the lights at 22:50.

start_state.mood: Excited and focused, ready to give my all to the test run.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: A mix of achievement and emotion, full of hope for the family's new chapter.
